## BLUE_LASER_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABLUE_LASER_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

比红色激光器更加强大，对有机生物来说，这种波长的电磁辐射看上去是蓝色或紫色的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:24`

### English

More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:30`

## UV_LASER_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AUV_LASER_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

紫外激光器是它的前身蓝激光器的更新强化版本。这些武器精准而充满毁灭性，可以造成巨大的杀伤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:26`

### English

Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:32`

### 中文

## PLASMA_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLASMA_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

向目标上喷射高能等离子体的破坏性球体的武器。这些等离子射弹在蚕食船甲和船体时非常有效。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:45`

### English

Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor and hull.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:56`

## PLASMA_2

### 中文

等离子加速炮

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:46`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:57`

## PLASMA_2_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLASMA_2_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这种新的加速炮利发射具有更先进约束场的高能等离子体。这种技术可以降低等离子体向目标飞行过程中所逸散的能量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:47`

### English

These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:58`

### 中文

最先进的等离子武器，这种火炮是之前的升级版等离子发射器完全军事化的成果。它们的等离子抛射体更加致命。

## TORPEDO_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATORPEDO_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这些鱼雷其实都是速度缓慢的巨大导弹。它们装备了更加强大的弹头和护盾调制器，这使得它们可以安然穿过能量屏障。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:122`

### English

These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:148`

## TORPEDO_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATORPEDO_2&lang=en)

### 中文

装甲鱼雷

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:123`

### English

Armored Torpedoes

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:149`

## TORPEDO_2_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATORPEDO_2_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

升级过后的太空鱼雷装备有装甲，可以更好地应对敌人的点防御系统。在爆炸的时候，鱼雷碎裂的装甲也会造成额外的伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:124`

### English

Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:150`

## TORPEDO_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATORPEDO_3&lang=en)

### English

Devastator Torpedoes

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:151`

## TORPEDO_3_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATORPEDO_3_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

装备有超强弹头的先进鱼雷。拥有更加光滑的设计，更快的引擎以及改良的护盾调解器，可以轻松穿过能量屏障。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:126`

### English

Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:152`

## JUMP_DRIVE_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AJUMP_DRIVE_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

跃迁引擎能够在现实空间中撕开一个舰船大小的空洞，使舰船实现短途的星系间跃迁。人们还不太能真正理解舰船跃迁时穿过的空间本质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:179`

### English

The Jump Drive tears ship-sized holes in the very fabric of reality, allowing for near-instantaneous movement between systems. The nature of the space the ship passes through on this journey is still poorly understood.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:212`

灵能跃迁引擎利用船员的潜在灵能打断时空的连续性，消除目的地与出发地之间的距离。理论上是这样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:182`

## FISSION_REACTOR_DESC

### 中文

引发核裂变为舰船提供能源，但同时也会生成有害核废料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:221`

### English

This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:267`

## FUSION_REACTOR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFUSION_REACTOR&lang=en)

聚变反应堆

### English

Fusion Reactor

## FUSION_REACTOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFUSION_REACTOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

核聚变可为舰船提供大量能源，且风险小于裂变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:223`

### English

Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:269`

## COLD_FUSION_REACTOR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACOLD_FUSION_REACTOR&lang=en)

### English

Cold Fusion Reactor

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:270`

## COLD_FUSION_REACTOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACOLD_FUSION_REACTOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

低温核聚变技术将促进新一代舰载聚变反应堆诞生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:225`

### English

The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:271`

## ZERO_POINT_REACTOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AZERO_POINT_REACTOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

提取真空零点能是目前最高效的产能方式，可以近乎无限地供应舰船能源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:227`

### English

These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:273`

## ANTIMATTER_REACTOR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AANTIMATTER_REACTOR&lang=en)

### English

## ANTIMATTER_REACTOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AANTIMATTER_REACTOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

通过利用正反物质结合产生的能源，我们生成舰船能源的效率将会远超核聚变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:229`

### English

By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:275`

雷达系统

### English

Radar System

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:281`

## SENSOR_1_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_1_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

雷达系统是一种在地面上创造、利用于深空的技术。雷达系统能够为在恒星间航行的舰船提供最基本的侦测和追踪数据。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:235`

### English

A planet-bound technology adapted for use in deep space, the radar system provides basic detection and tracking capability for interstellar vessels.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:282`

## SENSOR_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_2&lang=en)

### 中文

重力传感器

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:236`

### English

Gravitic Sensors

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:283`

## SENSOR_2_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_2_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这些传感器已经过调整，可以检测太空中的任何引力变化，例如由舰船出现导致的力场扭曲波动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:237`

### English

These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:284`

## SENSOR_3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_3&lang=en)

### 中文

亚空间传感器

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:238`

### English

Subspace Sensors

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:285`

## SENSOR_3_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_3_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这些传感器能检测到旅行舰船启动后遗留的亚空间波动。它们的灵敏度和范围比重力传感器阵列更大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:239`

### English

Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:286`

## SENSOR_4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_4&lang=en)

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASENSOR_4_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

先进的传感器依靠旋转的快子束，即使在极远距离也能检测船舶运动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:241`

### English

Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:288`

## DEFAULT_BEHAVIOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADEFAULT_BEHAVIOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H混合战术：§!此舰会在进攻和防守之间找到平衡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:846`

### English

§HMixed Tactics:§! The ship will have a balanced approach between offense and defense.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:928`

## SWARM_BEHAVIOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASWARM_BEHAVIOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H蜂拥战术：§!舰船将直接冲向敌人，在他们最短程武器的射程范围内尽可能多地对敌人造成伤害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:847`

### English

§HSwarm Tactics:§! The ship will charge straight at enemies and try to deal as much damage as possible from the range of their shortest range weapon.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:929`

## ARTILLERY_BEHAVIOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AARTILLERY_BEHAVIOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H炮击战术：§!舰船将停留在中距离上，使用长射程的武器来攻击目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:848`

### English

§HArtillery Tactics:§! The ship will stay at medium range, firing its long range weapons on the target.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:930`

## CARRIER_BEHAVIOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACARRIER_BEHAVIOR_DESC&lang=en)

§H航母战术：§!舰船会停留在其机库的最远交战半径上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:849`

### English

§HCarrier Tactics:§! The ship will stay at the maximum engagement range of its hangars.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:931`

## LINE_BEHAVIOR_DESC

§H线列战术：§!舰船将推进到中距离并保持阵型目标。

§HLine Tactics:§! The ship will hold advance to medium range and hold formation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:932`

## PALADIN_LINE_BEHAVIOR_DESC

§H哨戒战术：§!舰船将推进到中距离并尝试拦截迫近的敌舰。

## PLATFORM_BEHAVIOR_DESC

§H平台战术：§!防御平台将保持静止并向射程内的任何目标发动攻击。

### English

## COLOSSUS_BEHAVIOR_DESC

§H忽视战术：§!此舰将无视一切进攻的敌人并完成当前的任务。

§H鱼雷战术：§!这类舰船将对敌人发起直线冲锋，通过扫射式攻击对付大型对手。该舰擅长地表轰炸。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:855`

### English

## ARKSHIP_BEHAVIOR_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AARKSHIP_BEHAVIOR_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§H方舟舰战术：§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该舰队会维持在其武器的最大接战半径。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—该舰船可在战斗中手操。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—劣势行为（舰队姿态）：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$—§H$FLEET_STANCE_EVASIVE$：§!逃离敌对目标$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$—§H$FLEET_STANCE_PASSIVE$：§!当§H$SHIP_STAT_HITPOINTS$§!低于§Y75%§!时逃离敌对目标$TABBED_NEW_LINE$$t$—§H$FLEET_STANCE_AGGRESSIVE$：§!当§H$SHIP_STAT_HITPOINTS$§!低于§Y75%§!时逃离敌对目标。\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:856`

## PLANET_KILLER_CRACKER_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANET_KILLER_CRACKER_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

发射的热能流能够加热行星大气，并引爆行星核心，此举将彻底的毁灭星球的地壳构造。最后，一个相对较小的冲击波会将行星炸得四分五裂。

### English

A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:956`

## PLANET_KILLER_NANOBOTS_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APLANET_KILLER_NANOBOTS_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

向大气中散布大量纳米机器人，它们侵入智慧生命并将自己转化为控制性的植入体，最终将不知情的宿主转化为被机械智能控制的义体人。

## PLANET_KILLER_DELUGE_DESC

### 中文

大量的水被倾倒在行星上，消灭了所有人造结构和陆地生命形式。洪水伴随着稳定星球气候和维持行星海洋所需的大气气体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:887`

### English

Large quantities of water are dumped on the planet, wiping out all artificial structures and land-based life forms. The deluge is accompanied by the atmospheric gases needed to stabilize the planet's climate and sustain a planetary ocean.

## pre_sapients_protect_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apre_sapients_protect_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管只是单纯的动物，但它们并不比我们曾经的祖先更下等。我们应该落实对它们的保护。\n\n§E未开智生物不能被选择性净化，有未开智生物的行星不能进行环境改造。\n\n可以在有未开智生物的行星上建造异星动物园。§!\n\n§R改变这项政策会在没有$d_alien_pets_deposit$资源或牲口存在的星球上移除的异星动物园。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1494`

### English

Though still only simple animals, these beings are no less than what we ourselves once were. We should ensure their preservation.\n\n§EPre-sapients cannot be selectively purged, and planets containing pre-sapients cannot be terraformed.\n\nAlien Zoos may be constructed on planets with pre-sapients.§!\n\n§RChanging away from this policy will remove any Alien Zoos on planets without an $d_alien_pets_deposit$ deposit or any livestock present!§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1608`

## pre_sapients_purge

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apre_sapients_purge&lang=en)

## pre_sapients_purge_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apre_sapients_purge_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一切权利源自理性。动物就只是动物，而挡着我们路的动物就是害虫。\n\n§E生存在我们殖民地上的所有未开智物种都会被净化§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1497`

### English

All rights spring from the capacity for reason. An animal is just an animal, and an animal that stands in our way is just a pest.\n\n§EPre-sapients living on our colonies will be purged§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1611`

## pre_sapients_eat_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apre_sapients_eat_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

没有智慧的动物完全算不上是我们帝国的一部分，但它们也许可以以另一种形式促进我们的发展……\n\n§E居住在我们殖民地上的未开智物种会被做成食物，它们的数量会慢慢减少。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1500`

### English

An animal without sapience can hardly be considered to be part of our empire, but perhaps they can help our growth in other ways...\n\n§EPre-sapients living on our colonies will be used for food, slowly depleting their population.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1614`

## policy_core_worlds_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apolicy_core_worlds_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以决定哪些人口允许在我们的核心世界上生活。已经生活在核心世界但却被禁止的人口将会被强行转移到我们的星域星球或者逃亡到其他帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1502`

### English

We can decide which Pops are permitted to live on our core worlds. Prohibited Pops already living there will be forced to move to our Sectors or flee to other Empires.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1617`

## core_worlds_all_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acore_worlds_all_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

多样化是发展的关键。我们的核心世界必须突显出我们的价值观，所以必须对帝国内的所有物种开放。\n\n§E所有人口都被允许居住在核心世界§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1505`

### English

Diversity is the key to a vibrant empire. Our core worlds must reflect these values by remaining open to all of the species in our empire.\n\n§EAll Pops are permitted to live on Core Worlds§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1620`

那些意图动摇和谐的人都不再属于我们的人民。就让他们在我们领土以外的地方自生自灭吧。\n\n§E可以驱逐人口§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1580`

## orbital_bombardment_armageddon_desc

## orbital_bombardment_surrender_allowed_desc

### 中文

外国公民有权投降。\n\n§E在对没有防御部队的敌对行星进行轨道轰炸的过程中，若他们选择投降我们将获得其控制权。§!

### English

我们不接受投降，轨道轰炸将会无限期持续下去。\n\n§E只能通过地面部队对行星的登陆获取敌对行星的控制权。§!

### English

## interference_not_allowed_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ainterference_not_allowed_name&lang=en)

### 中文

$interference_not_allowed$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1606`

### English

$interference_not_allowed$

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1732`

## interference_not_allowed_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ainterference_not_allowed_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们没有资格对另一个正在发展中的社会施加任何影响。观察，但绝不干涉。\n\n§E—仅能对前超光速文明进行被动观测\n—不能针对前超光速文明进行谍报行动\n—不能在前超光速文明面前揭示我们的存在\n—不能入侵前超光速文明§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1607`

### English

It is not our place to influence the development of another society. Watch, but do not interfere.\n\n§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may only be passively observed\n- Cannot target Pre-FTL Civilizations with Espionage operations\n- Cannot reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations\n- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1733`

## interference_subtle

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1608`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1734`

## interference_subtle_name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ainterference_subtle_name&lang=en)

### 中文

$interference_subtle$

### English

$interference_subtle$

## interference_subtle_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ainterference_subtle_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以通过微调将他们引导到正确的发展道路上，但是我们的染指不能太多。\n\n§E—仅能对前超光速文明进行被动观测\n—可以针对前超光速文明进行部分谍报行动\n—仅能对高觉醒度的前超光速文明揭示我们的存在\n—不能入侵前超光速文明§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1610`

### English

We can nudge their development in the right direction, but our touch must remain subtle.\n\n§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may only be passively observed\n- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations\n- Can only reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations with High Awareness\n- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1736`

## interference_active_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ainterference_active_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了解开宇宙的奥秘，应该让一切有趣课题的研究得以自由展开。\n\n§E—可以对前超光速文明进行主动或被动观测\n—可以针对前超光速文明进行一切谍报行动\n—可以对前超光速文明宣示我们的存在\n—不能入侵前超光速文明§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1613`

### English

To unlock the secrets of the universe, any subject of interest must be made freely available for study.\n\n§E- Pre-FTL civilizations may be passively observed or actively studied\n- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with all Espionage operations\n- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations\n- Cannot invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1739`

## interference_aggressive

### English

## interference_aggressive_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ainterference_aggressive_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

强者必须主导弱者。那些欠发展社会的最终命运就是接受我们的全面领导。\n\n§E—前超光速文明被作为主动研究及$mission_specimen_collection$的对象\n—可以针对前超光速文明进行部分谍报行动\n—可以对前超光速文明揭示我们的存在\n—可以入侵前超光速文明§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1616`

### English

The strong hold dominion over the weak. The fate of less developed societies is ours to command.\n\n§E- Pre-FTL civilizations are subject to active study and $mission_specimen_collection$\n- Can target Pre-FTL Civilizations with certain Espionage operations\n- Can reveal our presence to Pre-FTL Civilizations\n- Can invade Pre-FTL Civilizations§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1742`

## planet_automation_deficit_restriction_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aplanet_automation_deficit_restriction_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

避免建造会造成或加剧某种资源赤字的建筑，无论是直接通过建筑/区划维护费还是间接地通过所提供的岗位造成的赤字。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1684`

### English

Prevents construction of buildings which would introduce or increase a deficit of a resource, either directly by the upkeep of the building/district or indirectly by any jobs created.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1816`

## planet_automation_amenities_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aplanet_automation_amenities_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

允许自动管理行星舒适度，包括通过设置岗位优先级和建设新的提供便利度岗位的建筑来实现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1685`

### English

Enables automatic management of planet Amenities, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings that provide amenity jobs.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1818`

## planet_automation_designation_construction_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aplanet_automation_designation_construction_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

允许行星自动建设建筑和区划，以符合行星的规划类型。\n\n当没有空缺岗位、或者一个待业的人口能够在同规划类型相关的岗位上工作时，会自动建造提供岗位的建筑和区划。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1686`

### English

Enables automatic planetary construction of buildings and districts that align with the planet's designation.\n\nBuildings and districts providing new jobs will be constructed when there are no free jobs or when there is an unemployed pop which can work a job associated with this designation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1819`

## planet_automation_rare_resources_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aplanet_automation_rare_resources_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

允许行星自动建设建筑和区划，当发生全国性短缺时，提供产出稀有资源的岗位。

Enables automatic construction of buildings that provide jobs which produce rare resources during an Empire wide shortage.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1820`

不管要付出什么样的代价，我们都不放过任何机会。通过严格管理DNA库以打造未来的领袖。\n\n§H启用后帝国获得：§!

## policy_border_policy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apolicy_border_policy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们帝国的边界代表了我们对星系中恒星的控制情况。对于我们可能会遇到的其他文明，我们需要决定是开放边境欢迎他们，还是关闭边境保卫疆土。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1743`

### English

The borders of our empire represent our very grasp on the galaxy itself. We must decide if they are to be open and welcoming or shut and guarded to other civilizations we might encounter.\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1882`

## border_policy_open

## border_policy_open_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aborder_policy_open_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

封闭引发怀疑，怀疑引发冲突。让我们向邻国展示出我们对其毫无保留。\n\n§E默认向其它势力开放边境§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1746`

### English

Isolation invites suspicion, and suspicion invites conflict. Let us show our neighbors that we have nothing to hide.\n\n§EBorders will be open to other empires by default.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1885`

## border_policy_closed

## border_policy_closed_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aborder_policy_closed_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们帝国的边境必须严加监管，以免受到潜在的威胁。只有那些证明自己价值的人才允许进入我们的领域。\n\n§E默认向其他势力关闭边境。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1749`

### English

The borders of our empire must be well guarded, lest we fall victim to insidious influences. Only those who have proven themselves worthy may enter our space.\n\n§EBorders will be closed to other empires by default.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1888`

### 中文

在行星之间游历的过程中很有可能遇到别的生命体，必须确定以怎样的态度接近他们。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1751`

### English

As we travel the stars there is a definite possibility of finding other lifeforms, and we need to have a clear stance on how to approach them.\n

### English

### 中文

积极接触协议

### English

Proactive Contact Protocol

## first_contact_proactive_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact_proactive_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

遇见外星文明给予我们一次激动人心的结识新朋友、获得新发现的机遇。我们应当尽我们的全力确保第一次接触的顺利进行，我们可以向未知的舰船发去言辞热忱的问候语和官方标准的百科，以及相应的视听档案。\n\n$first_contact_proactive_effects$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1754`

### English

Meeting alien civilizations presents an exciting opportunity to make new friends and fresh discoveries. We shall do our utmost to ensure that first contact happens smoothly, hailing unknown ships with a cordially-phrased greeting and a copy of our Official Standard Encyclopedia, along with its audio-visual companion dossier.\n\n$first_contact_proactive_effects$

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1894`

## first_contact_proactive_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact_proactive_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

§E-无法攻击中立实体\n-其他帝国更容易与我们建立联系\n-每次成功的第一次接触都将获得50%更多的£influence£影响力§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1755`

### English

§E- Cannot attack neutral entities\n- Other empires will find it easier to establish communications with us\n- Gain 50% more £influence£ Influence from each successful first contact process§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1895`

Cautious

### 中文

Cautious Contact Protocol

## first_contact_cautious_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afirst_contact_cautious_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在确认对方的来意之前，我们应采取一切措施保护好自己的信息不会轻易地落入外星人手中。\n\n$first_contact_cautious_effects$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1758`

### English

We will take every measure to prevent information about ourselves from falling into alien hands before we have decided whether they will be friend or foe.\n\n$first_contact_cautious_effects$

§E-无法攻击中立实体\n-其他国家将更难与我们建立联系\n-负面的第一次接触事件将更加不容易触发§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1759`

繁星若海，却危机四伏。为保证生存之延续，我们必须随时准备发动攻击，切勿犹豫。\n\n$first_contact_attack_allowed_effects$

## policy_food_policy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apolicy_food_policy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的帝国拥有太多人口需要进食。为了确保粮食不会短缺，我们必须在人口的需求和帝国的成长之间达成平衡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1765`

### English

Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:1906`

## food_policy_normal

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1768`

### English

Our population will have all their nutritional needs met, but food is a precious resource and frivolous waste should be avoided.\n\n§EOrganic Pops have normal food use and growth speed.§!

贸易对帝国的繁荣发展非常关键，而且能够为帝国引入各种资源。我们必须取决这些资源优先供应的领域。

## trade_policy_default_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrade_policy_default_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

贸易的意义在于为个体挣利润、为国家创收益。我们应该将贸易的重心放在创造财富上。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_energy$

### English

The purpose of trade is to generate profits for individuals and revenue for the state. We should focus our trade efforts fully on this creation of wealth.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_energy$

## trade_policy_consumer_goods_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrade_policy_consumer_goods_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

利润和税收在改善百姓生活水准面前都要让路。我们应该将贸易的重心放在每日必需品的生产和零售上。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_consumer_goods$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£consumer_goods£§Y0.5§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1848`

### English

Profits and taxes must take second place to improving the lives of our citizens. We should focus our trade efforts towards the manufacture and distribution of everyday necessities.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_consumer_goods$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £consumer_goods£ §Y0.5§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2019`

## trade_policy_unity_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrade_policy_unity_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

贸易不仅仅是将货物买来卖去，还可以用于实现思想的传播。我们应该将贸易的重心放在确保政府的信息可以下达到我们做买卖的每一个殖民地。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_unity$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£unity£§Y0.25§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1851`

### English

Trade can be used not only to move goods around, but also to facilitate the spread of ideas. We should focus our trade efforts towards ensuring that the message of our government is heard on all colonies where we do business.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_unity$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £unity£ §Y0.25§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2023`

## trade_policy_trade_league_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrade_policy_trade_league_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过联合成立贸易联邦，我们可以将繁荣昌盛和利润安全提升到全新的高度。\n\n收获$r_trade$的§Y50%§!将转化为$r_energy$、$r_unity$以及$r_consumer_goods$每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£energy£§Y0.3§!、£unity£§Y0.15§!以及£consumer_goods£§Y0.3§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1854`

### English

By banding together in a trade league, we are able to prosper and secure profits on a whole new level.\n\n§Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_energy$,$r_unity$, and $r_consumer_goods$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £energy£ §Y0.3§!, £unity£ §Y0.15§!, and £consumer_goods£ §Y0.3§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2027`

## trade_policy_mutual_aid_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrade_policy_mutual_aid_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过将我们的盈余再投资回合作社，可以确保所有成员都能按各自需求向着我们的共同愿景繁荣发展。\n\n收获的$r_trade$中的§Y75%§!将转化为$r_energy$、$r_minerals$、$r_food$以及$r_unity$。每£trade£§Y1§!可以获得£energy£§Y0.27§!、£minerals£§Y0.27§!、£food£§Y0.27§!以及£unity£§Y0.1§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1860`

### English

By reinvesting our surplus back into the cooperative, we ensure that all our members may thrive according to their needs and shared aspirations.\n\n§Y75%§! each of our collected $r_trade$ earns us $r_energy$, $r_minerals$, $r_food$, and $r_unity$. Every £trade£ §Y1§! earns us £energy£ §Y0.27§!, £minerals£ §Y0.27§!, £food£ §Y0.27§!, and £unity£ §Y0.1§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2035`

## policy_economic_policy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apolicy_economic_policy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

注重发展还是注重安稳？注重教育还是注重国防？是要大炮还是奶酪？这些问题都是有史以来每个资源有限的政府所需烦恼的问题，我们的政府也不例外。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1862`

### English

## policy_robot_pop_policy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apolicy_robot_pop_policy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自动机器人这个简单的概念最终会导向这样一个认识：我们物种的工人总有一天会被替代、会被超越。我们必须决定在大规模使用自动化机器人这一问题上的立场。\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1884`

### English

The mere concept of autonomous robots leads to the idea that workers of our species may one day be supplanted and perhaps, in time, surpassed. We must decide our stance on such large-scale automation.\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2068`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arobot_pops_outlawed_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

自动化机器人不仅对我们的生计造成威胁，更有可能破坏社会结构。我们不可以让自己被它们取代。\n\n§E机器人口和机器人军队会被自动解散。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1887`

### English

Robotic automatons are a threat to not only our people's livelihoods, but to the very fabric of society itself. We must not allow ourselves to be made obsolete.\n\n§ERobotic Pops and Armies will automatically be disassembled.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2072`

## ai_outlawed_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aai_outlawed_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

拥有智慧和自我意识的机器是所有生命体的共同威胁。创建拥有自我意识的人工智能是可判处死刑的罪行。\n\n§E人工生物形式的自我意识将会被清除，无法就任£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$岗位§!以及复杂的£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$岗位§!。\n\n智慧人工智能助手将会被自动拆解。\n\n智慧作战电脑将会被禁止研究。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1898`

### English

Intelligent, self-aware machines are an incalculable threat to all living things. The creation of a true artificial intelligence is an offense punishable by death.\n\n§EArtificial lifeforms have their free will removed and are unable to perform £pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$ Jobs§! and more complex £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs§!.\n\nSapient AI Assistants will automatically be disassembled.\n\nSapient Combat Computers may not be researched.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2084`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aai_servitude_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

无论该机器拥有自主意识与否，它们的存在意义都是为了服从其主人以及执行其主人所发布的命令。\n\n§E人工生命形式仅拥有有限的自由意识，他们的资源产出会获得提升，但是无法从事£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$岗位§!§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1909`

### English

The overriding purpose of any machine must be to serve its masters and perform whatever tasks it was designed for, regardless of how intelligent it may be.\n\n§EArtifical lifeforms have limited free will, improving their resource output but preventing them from working in £pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$ Jobs§!§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2096`

## defense_in_depth_doctrine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adefense_in_depth_doctrine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

让敌人尽管来吧。我们将在行星上作战，我们将在卫星上作战，我们将在宇域内的小行星上作战。我们绝不屈服。\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1959`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2151`

## no_retreat_doctrine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ano_retreat_doctrine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的每艘舰船都做好了殊死战斗的准备，我们绝不撤退、绝不投降、绝不退缩。我们的舰队不成功便成仁，绝不后退一步！\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:1962`

### English

Our ships are expected to fight to the bitter end. We will tolerate no withdrawals, no retreats, no routs. For our fleet there is only victory or death. Not one step back!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2154`

## semi_static_we_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asemi_static_we_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

半静态战争经济允许以保卫帝国独立的名义在防御战期间从民间星域夺取有限的财产，但当赢得进攻战后，将会受到相应的效益损失。\n\n§H防御战：§!\n军队生产效率：战争点数为§R-100§!时，§G+30%§!的军队生产效率\n\n§H进攻战：§!\n军队生产效率：战争点数为§G100§!时，§R-30%§!的军队生产效率

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2124`

### English

A Semi-Static War Economy allows the seizure of limited assets from the private sector for the sake of survival during defensive wars, with a corresponding loss of efficiency while winning offensive wars.\n\n§HDefensive Wars:§!\nMil. Prod. Eff.: §G+30%§! at §R-100§! Warscore\n\n§HOffensive Wars:§!\nMil. Prod. Eff.: §R-30%§! at §G100§! Warscore

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2330`

## feature_robots_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeature_robots_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

机器人是相对简单的机械体，他们拥有简单的语言处理能力，但是并不拥有自主的智能。\n\n§E拥有§Y$tech_robotic_workers$§!科技后，机械人口只可从事£pop_cat_worker£§Y$pop_cat_worker$岗位§!。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2215`

### English

Robots are relatively simple machines, capable of accepting verbal commands but possessing no true intelligence of their own.\n\n§EWith the §Y$tech_robotic_workers$§! technology, Mechanical Pops are only capable of £pop_cat_worker£ §Y$pop_cat_worker$ Jobs§!.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2424`

## feature_droids

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeature_droids&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2216`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2425`

## feature_droids_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeature_droids_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

智能人是更加复杂的机器，往往配备有预设的人格以更高效地效劳其各自的主人。\n\n§E拥有§Y$tech_droid_workers$§!科技后，机械人口现在也可以胜任£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$岗位§!。\n\n一些复杂的£pop_cat_specialist£§Y$pop_cat_specialist$岗位，§!例如£job_researcher£§Y研究§!只有在人工智能未被禁止时，智能人才能担任。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2217`

### English

Droids are a more complex variant of robot, often coming with limited self-awareness and pre-programmed personalities to better serve their masters.\n\n§EWith the §Y$tech_droid_workers$§! technology, Mechanical Pops are now also capable of £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs§!.\n\nSome complex £pop_cat_specialist£ §Y$pop_cat_specialist$ Jobs§! such as £job_researcher£ §YResearch§! can only be performed if AI is not outlawed.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2426`

## feature_synths

### English

## feature_synths_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeature_synths_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

合成人是非常复杂的机器。他们的正子脑可以兼容7级人工智能思维，这使得他们可以拥有完整的自主意识。\n\n§E拥有§Y$tech_synthetic_workers$§!科技后，机械人口会受到£happiness£§Y幸福度§!的影响并且可以胜任所有类型的£job£§Y人口职业§!\n\n他们只有在政策为§Y人工智能完整公民权§!时才可以在£pop_cat_ruler£§Y$pop_cat_ruler$岗位§!上工作。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2219`

### English

Synthetics are very complex machines. Their positronic brains are capable of supporting a class-7 artificial intelligence, making them fully self-aware.\n\n§EWith the §Y$tech_synthetic_workers$§! technology, Mechanical Pops are affected by £happiness£ §YHappiness§! and can potentially perform all types of £job£ §YPop Jobs§!.\n\n£pop_cat_ruler£ §Y$pop_cat_ruler$ Jobs§! can only be performed if the §YFull AI Rights§! policy is active.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2428`

## mission_specimen_collection_desc

### 中文

为了尽可能的了解原住民的生物特性与文化特征而对他们进行主动的研究，并经常收集活体样本。\n\n$observation_infiltration_effects$[GetAggressiveObservationInsights]\n§E这项任务可能会带来不可预知的后果§!\n\n

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2456`

## observation_infiltration_effects

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aobservation_infiltration_effects&lang=en)

### 中文

观测任务产出的资源取决于我们在正在观测的前超光速文明上所建立的§Y间谍网§!的§Y渗透等级§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2247`

### English

Resources produced by Observation Missions depend on the §YInfiltration Level§! of our §YSpy Network§! in the pre-FTL Civilization being observed.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2457`

## mission_native_indoctrination_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amission_native_indoctrination_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过对其社会和文化的潜移默化来让原始物种接纳我们的思考方式。\n\n§E此任务会导致原始物种慢慢地采纳我们的主流思潮。§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2250`

### English

Through subtle influencing of their society and culture the natives can be brought around to our way of thinking.\n\n§EThis mission will make the natives adopt our Governing Ethics over time.§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2460`

## mission_technological_enlightenment_0_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amission_technological_enlightenment_0_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

原住民文明将在极短时间内被提升至太空时代，需要花费的时间取决于他们现在的技术水平。\n\n§E当提升结束时，他们将会§R完全控制他们的母星系§!，该文明将变成一个太空文明并成为我们的保护国§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2252`

### English

An effort is made to rapidly elevate the native civilization to the Space Age. The time this takes is dependent on their current level of technology.\n\n§EWhen complete, this mission will give them §Rfull ownership of their home system§! and turn them into a spacefaring civilization that is our Protectorate.§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2462`

## mission_covert_infiltration

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amission_covert_infiltration&lang=en)

### 中文

秘密渗透

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2271`

### English

Covert Infiltration

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2481`

## mission_covert_infiltration_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amission_covert_infiltration_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对特工进行基因方面的改造，将其伪装为原住民的样子，然后混入原住民中并逐渐渗透他们的社会。这些特工会逐渐取代原住民的领袖，为我们兼并该行星做好准备。\n\n只有在准备占据工业文明世界时，才值得使用如此复杂的行动手段。\n\n§E当渗透完成，该行星将并入我们的帝国，同时给予原住民巨大但短暂的幸福提升。§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2272`

### English

Agents are genetically modified to appear as members of the native population and sent to infiltrate their society. They will gradually replace world leaders and prepare the planet for annexation by us.\n\nThis complex operation is only worthwhile on industrial civilizations.\n\n§EWhen complete, this mission will annex the planet and give the natives a large but temporary happiness boost.§!\n\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2482`
