## army_attachment_mobile_shield_generators

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_mobile_shield_generators&lang=en)

### 中文

移动护盾生成器

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2278`

### English

Mobile Shield Generators

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2490`

## army_attachment_mobile_shield_generators_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_mobile_shield_generators_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L大型履带载具上携带的生成器会在战场上生成防护力场，该力场对炮击和轨道轰炸有优秀的防御效果。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2279`

### English

§LGenerators carried on large tracked vehicles which generate a protective force field over a portion of the battlefield. When functional they provide excellent defense against artillery and orbital bombardment.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2491`

## army_attachment_personal_shields

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_personal_shields&lang=en)

### 中文

单人护盾单位

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2280`

### English

Personal Shield Units

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2492`

## army_attachment_personal_shields_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_personal_shields_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L该护盾生成器非常小，可以让士兵背在身后。虽然这种生成器所产生的防护力场无法长时间抵御连续的射击，但是也可以大大提高战场上士兵的生存几率。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2281`

### English

§LShield generators small enough to be carried on the back of a single individual. Their force fields can be overwhelmed with sustained fire, but this is still enough to significantly increase the lifespan of soldiers on the battlefield.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2493`

## army_attachment_military_police_corps

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_military_police_corps&lang=en)

### 中文

宪兵队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2282`

### English

Military Police Corps

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2494`

## army_attachment_military_police_corps_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_military_police_corps_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L一支庞大的宪兵部队。在前线的用途有限，但是他们的存在可以提升部队纪律。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2283`

### English

§LA large detachment of military police. They are of limited use on the front-lines, but their presence can improve unit discipline.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2495`

## army_attachment_battle_strider_column

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_battle_strider_column&lang=en)

### 中文

双足装甲战车群

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2284`

### English

Battle Strider Column

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2496`

## army_attachment_battle_strider_column_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_battle_strider_column_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L双足装甲战车几乎可以用于任何地形。虽然腿部容易受到针对性袭击，但是他们敏捷而又灵活的天性在战场上具有很大优势。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2285`

### English

§LBipedal armored fighting vehicles that are capable of operating in virtually any type of terrain. Their agile and flexible nature give them a distinct advantage on the battlefield, though they are vulnerable to attacks directed at their legs.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2497`

## army_attachment_hover_tank_battle_group

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_hover_tank_battle_group&lang=en)

### 中文

悬浮坦克战斗群

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2286`

### English

Hover Tank Battle Group

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2498`

## army_attachment_hover_tank_battle_group_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_hover_tank_battle_group_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L一种强大而移动迅速的装甲，它使用反重力升降装置在略高于地面处悬停。虽然这会使它的自身重量受到限制，但相对于常规履带载具，它们在速度和灵活性上做出了弥补。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2287`

### English

§LPowerful yet fast-moving armor that uses repulsor lifts to hover slightly above the ground. Although this limits their weight somewhat, their speed and agility make up for it when compared to conventional tracked vehicles.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2499`

## army_attachment_assault_landers

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_assault_landers&lang=en)

### 中文

突击运输机

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2288`

### English

Assault Landers

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2500`

## army_attachment_assault_landers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_assault_landers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些大型运输机的用途是在战时不依靠对接设施把军队和重型装备运送到行星表面。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2289`

### English

§LThese massive dropships are used to transport armies and their heavy equipment to a planet's surface under battle conditions and without the benefit of docking facilities.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2501`

## army_attachment_orbital_drop_pods

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_orbital_drop_pods&lang=en)

### 中文

轨道空降舱

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2290`

### English

Orbital Drop Pods

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2502`

## army_attachment_orbital_drop_pods_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_orbital_drop_pods_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L单人用空降舱会从轨道上的舰船里发射到行星表面。虽然重型装备的运送还是要依靠突击着陆器，但是这些空降舱在入侵行星时也能显著减少运送时间。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2291`

### English

§LSingle use drop pods that are launched onto a planet's surface from a ship in orbit. While heavier equipment still needs to be brought in with assault landers, these pods significantly decrease the time spent between orbit and planetfall during planetary invasions.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2503`

## army_attachment_neo_concrete_fortifications

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_neo_concrete_fortifications&lang=en)

### 中文

新实体堡垒

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2292`

### English

Neo-Concrete Fortifications

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2504`

## army_attachment_neo_concrete_fortifications_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_neo_concrete_fortifications_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L新实体地面堡垒的扩展层和掩体网为轨道轰炸提供了进一步防护。这限制了陆军的机动性，但在防御作战时会成为关键。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2293`

### English

§LExtensive layers of neo-concrete ground fortifications and bunker networks that offer increased protection against orbital bombardment. This restricts the mobility of the army, but can be a deciding factor in defensive actions.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2505`

## army_attachment_self_replicating_mine_fields

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_self_replicating_mine_fields&lang=en)

### 中文

自我复制雷区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2294`

### English

Self-Replicating Mine Fields

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2506`

## army_attachment_self_replicating_mine_fields_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_self_replicating_mine_fields_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L埋藏式和半移动式地雷不断进行自我复制以维持所需的数量。清除这种能够自我复制的雷区将会异常困难，尤其是在战斗当中。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2295`

### English

§LBurrowing and semi-mobile mines that continually replicate copies of themselves to maintain their numbers. Clearing these self-replicating mine fields can be exceptionally difficult, especially during combat.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2507`

## army_attachment_air_defense_artillery

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_air_defense_artillery&lang=en)

### 中文

防空炮

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2296`

### English

Air Defense Artillery

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2508`

## army_attachment_air_defense_artillery_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_air_defense_artillery_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L一个非常庞大的武器系统，可以追踪和袭击快速移动的进入行星的大气层的目标。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2297`

### English

§LA large collection of weapon systems designed to track and engage fast-moving objects as they enter a planet's atmosphere.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2509`

## army_attachment_chemical_stimulants

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_chemical_stimulants&lang=en)

### 中文

化学兴奋剂

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2298`

### English

Chemical Stimulants

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2510`

## army_attachment_chemical_stimulants_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_chemical_stimulants_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L一种烈性化学混合试剂，专门用于增强士兵的战斗感知和反应能力。可以暂时性地提升士兵的作战表现，但是持续使用可能导致焦虑、抑郁、癫痫、恶心、幻觉、嗜睡和大便失禁。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2299`

### English

§LPotent cocktail of chemicals designed to increase the combat awareness and reflexes of a soldier. Field performance increases temporarily, but continued use may result in anxiety, depression, seizures, nausea, hallucinations, narcolepsy and uncontrollable bowel movement.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2511`

## army_attachment_xeno_cavalry

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_xeno_cavalry&lang=en)

### 中文

异星铁骑

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2300`

### English

Xeno Cavalry

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2512`

## army_attachment_xeno_cavalry_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_xeno_cavalry_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些凶猛的战争野兽一旦被骑手所驯服，就会成为优秀的坐骑。它们几乎可以翻越任何地形，非常适合进行侦察任务和突击任务。大型战争野兽有时也会被成功地用作重型武器平台§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2301`

### English

§LThese sturdy war beasts make excellent mounts, once they have finished bonding with their riders. They can traverse almost any terrain, and have proven very effective in scouting and raiding roles. Larger specimens have also been used with success as heavy weapon platforms.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2513`

## army_attachment_psi_warriors

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_psi_warriors&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能战士

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2302`

### English

PSI Warriors

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2514`

## army_attachment_psi_warriors_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_psi_warriors_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些精英战士充满了神秘色彩，他们凭借强大的灵能能力和坚实的身体素质在战场上驰骋。灵能战士精通近战武器，他们更喜欢和敌人近身肉搏。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2303`

### English

§LThese elite warriors are shrouded in mystery, relying on their powerful psionic abilities and extensive physical training to move about the battlefield. They prefer to engage their opponents in close combat, and many are extremely proficient with melee weapons.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2515`

## army_attachment_gene_warrior_shock_troops

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_gene_warrior_shock_troops&lang=en)

### 中文

基因战士突击队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2304`

### English

Gene Warrior Shock Troops

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2516`

## army_attachment_gene_warrior_shock_troops_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_gene_warrior_shock_troops_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这是一群能力远超于普通士兵的强大战士，他们最适合去战斗进入胶着状态的地方执行突击或奇袭任务。一队基因战士有时足以扭转整个战局。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2305`

### English

§LFormidable warriors that tower over regular soldiers, they are best used as shock troops or mobile strike forces where the fighting is thickest. A company of these fighters can sometimes be enough to turn an entire battle around.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2517`

## army_attachment_power_armor

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_power_armor&lang=en)

### 中文

动力装甲

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2306`

### English

Power Armor

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2518`

## army_attachment_power_armor_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_power_armor_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L动力装甲可以提升士兵的天生能力，装备后，士兵的耐力和力量都会增强。动力装甲能让他们携带更重型的武器，还可以对辐射和生化制剂进行更好的防护。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2307`

### English

§LSuits of powered armor that augment the natural abilities of soldiers, increasing both their strength and endurance. The armor allows them to carry heavier ordnance, while also offering better protection against radiation as well as chemical and biological agents.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2519`

## army_attachment_special_forces_group

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_special_forces_group&lang=en)

### 中文

特种作战小队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2308`

### English

Special Forces Group

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2520`

## army_attachment_special_forces_group_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_special_forces_group_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些训练有素的特工专门执行非常规行动，通常会以极机密的方式暗中深入敌后，并优先摧毁敌人的通讯和物流，同时寻找机会除掉一切有价值的目标。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2309`

### English

§LHighly trained operatives that engage in unconventional operations, usually clandestinely behind enemy lines. Disruption of enemy communication and logistics are prioritized, along with the elimination of any high-value targets of opportunity.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2521`

## army_attachment_shadow_assassins

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_shadow_assassins&lang=en)

### 中文

暗影杀手

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2310`

### English

Shadow Assassins

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2522`

## army_attachment_shadow_assassins_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_shadow_assassins_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些精英特工穿着昂贵的隐形衣，利用隐形技术执行任务。除了在快速移动时会轻微变形，肉眼和大多数传感器无法对其进行观测。他们是暗杀和秘密军事情报收集的专家。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2311`

### English

§LThese elite special forces operatives wear expensive stealth suits utilizing cloaking technology. They are invisible to the naked eye and most sensors, aside from a slight rippling distortion when moving quickly. Experts at assassination and covert military intelligence gathering.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2523`

## army_attachment_cyborg_infiltration_unit

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_cyborg_infiltration_unit&lang=en)

### 中文

义体人渗透小队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2312`

### English

Cyborg Infiltration Unit

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2524`

## army_attachment_cyborg_infiltration_unit_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_cyborg_infiltration_unit_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些机械杀手的金属骨骼可以自由变形，这使得他们可以在取得合适的血肉（通常是从俘虏身上得来）移植到自身骨架上之后伪装成任何物种。然后渗入敌军防线制造混乱。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2313`

### English

§LThe metal endoskeleton of these mechanical killers is highly transformable, enabling them to assume the appearance of any species after an appropriate layer of flesh (usually acquired from enemy prisoners) is grafted onto their frame. They then infiltrate enemy lines and spread chaos.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2525`

## army_attachment_hunter_killer_drone_swarms

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_hunter_killer_drone_swarms&lang=en)

### 中文

猎杀者无人机群

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2314`

### English

Hunter-Killer Drone Swarms

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2526`

## army_attachment_hunter_killer_drone_swarms_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_hunter_killer_drone_swarms_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L以压制敌人为目的，向敌人阵地投放大量相对简单的无人机群。尽管单独一架无人机不会对训练有素的士兵造成什么威胁，但是成百上千架无人机就不那么好对付了。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2315`

### English

§LMassive swarms of these relatively simple unmanned aerial vehicles are unleashed on enemy positions in the hope of overwhelming them. Although a single drone may not be a significant threat to a trained soldier, several dozen are.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2527`

## army_attachment_combat_software_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_combat_software_2&lang=en)

### 中文

作战软件 v2.0

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2316`

### English

Combat Software 2.0

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2528`

## army_attachment_combat_software_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_combat_software_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L对军队中所有单元的战斗软件进行一次全面的升级。这包括改进的反应时间，更新的战术分析算法和大量的漏洞修复。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2317`

### English

§LA comprehensive upgrade to the combat software of all units in this army. This includes improved reaction-times, updated tactical analysis algorithms and a vast number of minor bug fixes.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2529`

## army_attachment_exploding_slave_collars

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_exploding_slave_collars&lang=en)

### 中文

可引爆的奴隶项圈

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2318`

### English

Exploding Slave Collars

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2530`

## army_attachment_exploding_slave_collars_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_exploding_slave_collars_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些项圈将被佩戴在奴隶身上（具体的佩戴位置由奴隶的身体结构决定），如果奴隶违背主人，就可以对项圈进行远程引爆。有些指挥官会在奴隶与敌人近身战斗时引爆奴隶的项圈，从而对敌人造成巨大伤害。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2319`

### English

§LThese collars are attached to slaves (placement depends on anatomy), and can be detonated by remote signal if they act against the wishes of their masters. Shrewd commanders have been known to detonate collars during close quarters fighting to inflict damage on enemy forces.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2531`

## army_attachment_slaver_raiding_teams

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_slaver_raiding_teams&lang=en)

### 中文

奴隶突击队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2320`

### English

Slave Raiding Teams

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2532`

## army_attachment_slaver_raiding_teams_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_slaver_raiding_teams_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些奴隶小队主要由已获得释放的奴隶组成，专门在敌军后方进行游击战，并俘虏更多的奴隶。这些被捕获的俘虏会被重新送上战场，与他们之前的战友进行对抗。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2321`

### English

§LThese slaver teams, many consisting of former slaves themselves, use hit-and-run attacks on enemy rear areas for the purpose of capturing more slaves. After some rapid conditioning, the captured slaves are then thrown into circulation on the battlefield against their former comrades.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2533`

## army_attachment_commissar_squads

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_commissar_squads&lang=en)

### 中文

政委小组

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2322`

### English

Commissar Squads

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2534`

## army_attachment_commissar_squads_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_commissar_squads_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L维持奴隶部队的纪律是一项艰难的任务，但对于政委小组来说却是小菜一碟。通过实行抽杀法和其他严厉的惩戒，奴隶们会畏惧政委胜过敌人。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2323`

### English

§LEnforcing discipline in an army of slaves is a monumental task, but these squads of hardened commissars have turned it into an art. Decimation and other harsh disciplinary actions are used to ensure the slaves fear the ire of the commissars more than the enemy.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2535`

## army_attachment_clone_suicide_brigade

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_clone_suicide_brigade&lang=en)

### 中文

克隆人自杀旅

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2324`

### English

Clone Suicide Brigade

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2536`

## army_attachment_clone_suicide_brigade_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_clone_suicide_brigade_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L繁殖克隆人只有一个目的——寻找敌人集合密度最高的区域，潜入其中并引爆身上的炸弹。这种随机的令人惊骇行为可以大大的打击敌方士气。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2325`

### English

§LClones bred with a single overriding purpose in mind - to seek out concentrations of enemy forces, dive into their midst and detonate the explosives strapped onto their bodies. These random acts of terror often cause considerable damage to enemy morale.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2537`

## army_attachment_clone_commandos

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_clone_commandos&lang=en)

### 中文

克隆人突击队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2326`

### English

Clone Commandos

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2538`

## army_attachment_clone_commandos_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_clone_commandos_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L培育这些加速成长的杀手们需要昂贵的成本，但是在极度的调整和训练之下，可以使他们成为优秀的士兵。他们比普通克隆人的自主性更强，甚至其中有一些人开始发展出了某些怪癖。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2327`

### English

§LThese vat-grown killers are expensive to produce, but the extreme conditioning and training they are subjected to turn them into very capable soldiers. They are more independent-minded than normal clones, and some models have been known to develop eccentric quirks.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2539`

## army_attachment_hypnotic_training_regimen

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_hypnotic_training_regimen&lang=en)

### 中文

催眠训练方案

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2328`

### English

Hypnotic Training Regimen

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2540`

## army_attachment_hypnotic_training_regimen_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_hypnotic_training_regimen_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L为了让克隆人士兵发挥出最大战斗力，用催眠训练的方案来对他们进行超高强度的训练。尽管作战单位参战时间严重超标可能导致精神崩溃，但这种训练方式可以进一步提高作战效率。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2329`

### English

§LThe clone soldiers have been put through an extensive regimen of hypnotic training, beyond their normal conditioning. This further improves combat efficiency, although units that far exceed their battlefield lifetime expectancy are sometimes prone to psychotic breakdowns.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2541`

## army_attachment_psi_shield_specialists

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_psi_shield_specialists&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能护盾专家

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2330`

### English

PSI-Shield Specialists

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2542`

## army_attachment_psi_shield_specialists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_psi_shield_specialists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L以在战场上为友军展开强力灵能护盾为目的，专门受训的特工。这样的护盾和传统能源力场效果一样，但是要维持护盾状态需要消耗大量的专注力。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2331`

### English

§LOperatives that have been specifically trained to project powerful psionic shields over friendly positions on the battlefield. These shields can be every bit as potent as conventional energy force fields, but maintaining them requires a lot of concentration.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2543`

## army_attachment_telekinetic_specialists

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_telekinetic_specialists&lang=en)

### 中文

念力移物专家

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2332`

### English

Telekinetic Specialists

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2544`

## army_attachment_telekinetic_specialists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_telekinetic_specialists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L在念力移物方面有特殊天分的灵能专家。在恰当的条件下，他们可以将敌人和载具扔到半空，或将飞机从天上摔向地面。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2333`

### English

§LPsionic specialists who have shown a particular talent for manipulating their environment. In the right conditions, they are capable of hurling enemy soldiers and vehicles into the air, or plucking aircraft from the sky and slamming them into the ground.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2545`

## army_attachment_class_a_psi_operative

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_class_a_psi_operative&lang=en)

### 中文

A级灵能特工

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2334`

### English

Class-A PSI Operative

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2546`

## army_attachment_class_a_psi_operative_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_class_a_psi_operative_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L灵力强大的稀有个体，他们通常忍受着大脑受创的副作用。这些特工对自己和周围环境都极度危险，但当他们的毁灭性力量被导向敌人的时候，就会成为强大的武器。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2335`

### English

§LRare individuals wielding tremendous psionic power, usually with the unfortunate side-effect of fraying their minds. They are extremely dangerous both to themselves and their environment, but can be a formidable weapon when their destructive energies are directed towards the enemy.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2547`

## army_attachment_infestation_brood

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_infestation_brood&lang=en)

### 中文

感染孢子

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2336`

### English

Infestation Brood

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2548`

## army_attachment_infestation_brood_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_infestation_brood_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L被释放后，这些凶残的寄生生物会迅速寻找宿主以繁殖后代。它们将以指数级的速度增长，整个城市会因此在几天之内覆灭。不必多说，对敌人士气的打击也是毁灭性的。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2337`

### English

§LWhen unleashed, these violent parasitic creatures immediately seek out hosts to implant with their offspring. This allows them to breed at an exponential rate, and entire cities can be wiped out in a matter of days. Needless to say, their presence does not have a positive effect on enemy morale.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2549`

## army_attachment_brood_coordinator

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_brood_coordinator&lang=en)

### 中文

协调之母

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2338`

### English

Brood Coordinator

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2550`

## army_attachment_brood_coordinator_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_brood_coordinator_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L该巨大的如鼻涕虫一样的生物被养在前线后方来对异星军团内各种生物进行协调。它使用低级的灵能信号来和异星军团进行交流。它除了气味难闻之外，还经常让饲养员感到严重的头痛。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2339`

### English

§LThis massive, slug-like creature is kept behind the front lines to improve the coordination of the ravenous creatures in a xenomorph army. It uses low-level psionic signals to communicate with the horde, and a complaint unrelated to its odor is that its handlers often suffer from severe headaches.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2551`

## army_attachment_battle_worms

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_battle_worms&lang=en)

### 中文

坑道虫

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2340`

### English

Battle Worms

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2552`

## army_attachment_battle_worms_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_battle_worms_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些经过基因改造的巨大的无脊椎动物能够钻入地面，绕过敌人的防线并且可以让更小的生物使用它们挖好的隧道。它们挖出的隧道同时也能用来防御轨道轰炸。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2341`

### English

§LThese colossal annelids have been genetically engineered to burrow through the ground, bypassing enemy defenses and allowing smaller creatures to follow their wake. The tunnels they dig also provide excellent shelter from orbital bombardment.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2553`

## army_attachment_raptor_flocks

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_raptor_flocks&lang=en)

### 中文

猛禽战队

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2342`

### English

Raptor Flocks

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2554`

## army_attachment_raptor_flocks_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_raptor_flocks_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L大型猛禽，在有限时间内可以达到超音速。它们成群进行攻击，发射可穿透大多数装甲的硬刺。任何冒险进入它们巢穴上空大气层的飞行器都会有极高遭受攻击的危险。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2343`

### English

§LLarge flying predators capable of reaching supersonic speeds for limited periods. They attack in flocks, firing streams of hardened spines that are capable of penetrating most armor. Any aircraft venturing into the atmosphere above a nest of these creatures is at risk of attack.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2555`

## army_attachment_advanced_power_armor

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_advanced_power_armor&lang=en)

### 中文

先进型动力装甲

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2344`

### English

Advanced Power Armor

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2556`

## army_attachment_advanced_power_armor_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_advanced_power_armor_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这些动力装甲的成本几乎和制造基因战士本身一样昂贵。它们可以进一步提升使用者的力量，其飞行装置也给使用者带去了难以想象的机动能力。为了操作装甲，使用者需要与装甲建立神经链接。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2345`

### English

§LThese expensive suits of armor are almost as expensive to produce as the gene warriors themselves. They further augment the already considerable strength of their users, and jet packs offer increased mobility. To operate, the suit requires its wearer to establish a nerve-link.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2557`

## army_attachment_environmental_augmentations

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_environmental_augmentations&lang=en)

### 中文

环境增强装置

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2346`

### English

Environmental Augmentations

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2558`

## army_attachment_environmental_augmentations_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_environmental_augmentations_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L进一步提升肺部以及免疫系统从而使基因武士可以在不利环境中仍然正常运行且不受损伤——短期内甚至可以在真空中运行。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2347`

### English

§LFurther improvements to the lungs and immune systems enable the gene warriors to function without impairment in hostile environments - even the vacuum of space for limited periods.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2559`

## army_attachment_cybernetic_replacements

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_cybernetic_replacements&lang=en)

### 中文

义体改造

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2348`

### English

Cybernetic Replacements

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2560`

## army_attachment_cybernetic_replacements_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aarmy_attachment_cybernetic_replacements_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L战斗中损伤的器官与四肢均可以先进的义体植入体替代，可让残废的战士在承受巨大伤害后仍然继续战斗。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2349`

### English

§LOrgans and limbs damaged or lost in battle are replaced with advanced cybernetic implants, allowing crippled warriors to remain in service even after suffering grievous injuries.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2561`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DESPOTIC_EMPIRE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DESPOTIC_EMPIRE&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们历史早期的混乱时代里，许多帝国争权逐利，最后最强者统一了一切。只有在强大统一的领导之下，帝国才能挖掘出全部的潜能。在那之后，和平稳定和科学发展也就是顺其自然的事情。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2603`

### English

The early chaotic periods of our history saw many nation states vying with each other for power, until we were at last united under the strongest of these. Only when guided by a single vision could we reach our full potential, and an era of stability and scientific progress followed.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2820`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_OLIGARCHY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_OLIGARCHY&lang=en)

### 中文

随着科学知识的增长和新哨站在我们世界中的广泛建立，贸易繁荣使得不同的国家联系愈发紧密，直至成为一个单一实体。权力归于富商巨贾———那些成就我们文明的真正缔造者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2604`

### English

As scientific knowledge increased and new outposts were founded across our world, trade flourished and tied the various nation states together until they became a single entity. Power rested with the merchant princes, the true architects of our achievements as a civilization.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2821`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_REPRESENTATIVE_DEMOCRACY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_REPRESENTATIVE_DEMOCRACY&lang=en)

### 中文

稳定的科技进步驱策着我们前行，国家间的武装冲突愈发稀少。终于，全球性的民主政府框架摆在了我们面前，随着最后的抗拒者们终于志愿加入，我们联合一体，统一为一个国家。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2605`

### English

We were driven forward by steady scientific progress, and armed conflicts between nation states became increasingly rare. The framework for a global democratic government was eventually laid, and when the last holdouts voluntarily joined we stood united as a single nation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2822`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_THEOCRATIC_MONARCHY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_THEOCRATIC_MONARCHY&lang=en)

### 中文

古往今来，许多虚假的先知在我们的人民前行路上提供着精神引导，但是只有真正的信仰取得了胜利。随着最后的异教徒要塞在数次付出巨大牺牲的圣战后被征服，在神授领袖领导下的我们在神圣意志下团结一体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2606`

### English

Many false prophets took it upon themselves to offer spiritual guidance to our people as we advanced through the ages, but the true faith prevailed. The last heathen strongholds were vanquished after several ferocious crusades, uniting us under the holy will of a single divine leader.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2823`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_THEOCRATIC_OLIGARCHY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_THEOCRATIC_OLIGARCHY&lang=en)

### 中文

随着科技的发展，许多信念也在民间孕育而生，这些教派互相争夺信徒。这些派系之间的斗争时而和缓时而激烈。最终，真正的信念传遍了世界的每个角落，充满信念的人们也皈依在了同一个宗教之下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2607`

### English

As we progressed through the technological ages, there were many religions among our people that contended with each other for followers. Gradually, sometimes peacefully and sometimes less so, the true faith found its way to all corners of our world and the faithful were united under a single universal church.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2824`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_THEOCRATIC_REPUBLIC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_THEOCRATIC_REPUBLIC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不断的对宇宙进行探索，并在精神层面寻求自己在宇宙中扮演的角色，在这一过程中，我们取得了巨大的成就。我们创立了一个由博学多才的教士所组成的委员会，专门辅佐人们选举出的领袖。该传统一直持续至今。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2608`

### English

Great achievements were made, both in the advancement of science and on the spiritual plane as we sought to expand our understanding of the universe and the role we play in it. A council of our most learned priests was convened to advise our elected leaders, a tradition that continues to this day.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2825`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_STAR_EMPIRE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_STAR_EMPIRE&lang=en)

### 中文

科技不断快速发展，但是我们人口的增长也使得人们的需求愈发无法被满足。当我们的世界在陷入混乱的边缘时，军队开始介入以恢复法律秩序。新的秩序被建立起来，以保护我们的国家免受各种内部或外部威胁的侵害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2609`

### English

Technological progress has been swift, but as our numbers grew the civilian population became increasingly restless. With our world on the brink of anarchy, the military stepped in to restore the rule of law. A new order was established to safeguard our nation from all threats, both external and internal.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2826`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MILITARY_REPUBLIC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MILITARY_REPUBLIC&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们在历史长河中不断进步时，我们早期的许多民族国家深受军队和社会管理机构之间持久权力斗争之苦。如今一种崭新的政府形式使得双方达成了和解，彼此唇齿相依。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2610`

### English

As we advanced through the ages, many of our earliest nation states suffered greatly from the constant power struggles between the military and civilian institutions that governed society. A compromise was reached in a new form of government, where one could not exist without the other.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2827`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MARTIAL_EMPIRE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MARTIAL_EMPIRE&lang=en)

### 中文

在过去科技不断进步的时代中，无数的国家和民族此起彼伏，他们相互攻伐，直至剩下唯一的胜利者。尽管战斗异常残酷，但是最后的胜利者所带来的尚武传统流传至今。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2611`

### English

Countless nation states formed as we advanced through the technological ages, warring against each other until only one remained. Although the fighting was often brutal, those who survived nurtured a martial tradition that has prevailed to this day.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2828`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_ASSEMBLY_OF_CLANS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_ASSEMBLY_OF_CLANS&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们在历史长河中不断进步时，我们早期的许多民族国家深受军队和社会管理机构之间持久权力斗争之苦。如今一种崭新的政府形式使得双方达成了和解，彼此唇齿相依。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2612`

### English

As we advanced through the ages, many of our earliest nation states suffered greatly from the constant power struggles between the military and civilian institutions that governed society. A compromise was reached in a new form of government, where one could not exist without the other.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2829`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CITIZEN_STRATOCRACY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CITIZEN_STRATOCRACY&lang=en)

### 中文

在历史早期，我们的国家之间纷争不断，无力保卫自己的国家要么消失了、要么被强大的国家所兼并。无休止的战争培育出了人们尚武的传统。直到现今，只有那些愿意为保护国家而牺牲自己的人才有资格获得完整人民身份。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2613`

### English

Many wars were fought between our early nation states, and those who could not defend themselves disappeared or were absorbed by stronger neighbors. These endless wars fostered a strong martial tradition, and to this day full citizenship is reserved for those who have proved willing to sacrifice themselves in defense of the state.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2830`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_IRENIC_MONARCHY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_IRENIC_MONARCHY&lang=en)

### 中文

我们文明中的动荡时代终于告一段落了，有史以来第一次统一在单独一位统治者之下。从此以后我们的帝国进入飞速发展的和平时代，直到今时今日。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2614`

### English

The violent periods of our history reached a peaceful conclusion when we were united under a single monarch for the first time. An unbroken era of peace and prosperity followed, which has lasted to this day.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2831`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_IRENIC_BUREAUCRACY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_IRENIC_BUREAUCRACY&lang=en)

### 中文

不幸的是，我们散漫的头脑仍然容易出现情感波动，有时导致暴力。随着科技进步、武器越发致命，我们建立了一个复杂的行政系统，保护人们不受各种侵害——包括他们自身的侵袭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2615`

### English

Unfortunately, our undisciplined minds were still prone to emotional outbursts that could sometimes lead to violence. As weapons became more deadly with each passing technological age, a complex system of government was devised to protect our citizens from harmful elements - including themselves.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2832`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MORAL_DEMOCRACY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MORAL_DEMOCRACY&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们在历史长河中不断进步时，我们作为一整个物种也越发成熟。继承自祖先的暴力和原始冲动被妥善处理，全球政府在和平共存的基础上建立起来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2616`

### English

As we advanced through the technological ages, we also matured as a species. The violent and base impulses we inherited from our ancestors were done away with, and a global government was formed on the principles of peaceful coexistence.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2833`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CELESTIAL_EMPIRE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_CELESTIAL_EMPIRE&lang=en)

### 中文

在文明的早期，我们的人们身处黑暗之中，难以抵抗争斗的本能。然后某一天，天空中的乌云消散，一道灵光突然从天而降，照耀在我们的首任天君身上。至此，统一的时代终于来临了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2617`

### English

There was much darkness and sorrow in the early ages, as our people frequently gave in to their base instincts and turned upon one another. Then, suddenly, the clouds parted and a light from the heavens appeared, shining down upon the one who would become our first Celestial monarch. We were united at last.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2834`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DESPOTIC_HEGEMONY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DESPOTIC_HEGEMONY&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管过去我们在科技时代中快速发展，但作为一个物种我们仍旧支离破碎，效率低下。在这混乱的时代中，一个全新出现的制度让我们摆脱迷信，为我们的社会带来秩序。一些人因不理智的恐惧抗拒这一变革，但是在数次平定战争之后，他们同样成为了一个更加伟大整体的一员。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2618`

### English

Despite our rapid progression through the technological ages, as a species we were fragmented and inefficient. A new system emerged during these chaotic times that delivered us from superstitious beliefs and brought order to society. Some resisted this change out of irrational fear, but after several pacification wars they too became productive components of a greater whole.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2835`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_EXECUTIVE_COMMITTEE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_EXECUTIVE_COMMITTEE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们历史早期的混乱时代，最终催生了一个全新的政体，破天荒地将我们的民族紧紧地团结在一起。面对残酷的统治者，我们没有妥协。面对懵懂众生，我们也没有妥协。最终我们发展出了一个由公正无私的统治者们所管理的社会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2619`

### English

The chaotic periods of our early history eventually gave rise to a new society which unified our people as none had done before. Succumbing neither to tyranny nor to the ignorance of the masses, our society evolved into one that is ruled fairly by a just and unbiased bureaucratic machine.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2836`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DIRECT_DEMOCRACY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DIRECT_DEMOCRACY&lang=en)

### 中文

当科技水平发展到能够实现即时通讯的时候，原先各自为政效率低下的帝国开始融为一体，形成了一个真正的民主政体，体制内的每一位人们都拥有参与重大决定的话语权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2620`

### English

As our technology progressed to a level that allowed for instantaneous communications, our inefficient nation states merged together to form a true democracy, with every citizen having a say in important decisions.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2837`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_ILLUMINATED_AUTOCRACY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_ILLUMINATED_AUTOCRACY&lang=en)

### 中文

科学和理性思维的诞生最终推翻了阻碍着科技发展的无知、迷茫、愚钝或者三者兼有的统治者。从此，合格的领袖是由科学团体所推举出来的，他们会引导我们的帝国走向更光辉的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2621`

### English

The birth of science and rational thought necessitated the removal of those political leaders who impeded technological progress through ignorance, superstition, sheer stupidity or a combination of the three. Instead, a single qualified ruler from the scientific community would be chosen to guide our developing nation into the future.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2838`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_SCIENCE_DIRECTORATE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_SCIENCE_DIRECTORATE&lang=en)

### 中文

科技的发展为我们破除了祖先那里流传下来的迷茫。人们大众开始形成理性的思维方式。旧时那效率十分低下的帝国形式已成为历史；现在一群成果颇丰的科学家所组成的委员会来领导该帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2622`

### English

Through scientific progress, we have managed to stamp out the superstitions that ruled the minds of our ancestors. As reason and rational thought spread among our people, the inefficient nation states that we had until then organized ourselves into were disbanded, and a council of our most accomplished scientists was gathered to rule in their stead.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2839`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_RATIONAL_CONSENSUS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_RATIONAL_CONSENSUS&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的祖先都是无知和迷茫的受害者。这段黑暗的历史一直持续到科学和理性思维发展成为我们帝国的指导方针为止。一个全新的民主体系诞生了，所有的大事都是以少数服从多数来决定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2623`

### English

Alas, our ancestors were victims of ignorance and superstition in the early eras. This dark period of our history lasted until science and rationality were firmly established as the guiding principles of our society. A new democratic system of government was introduced where important decisions were made by consensus.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2840`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MEGACORPORATION

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MEGACORPORATION&lang=en)

### 中文

在早期时代，我们的民族是由原始的封建帝国和低效的民族帝国所组成。随着全球贸易的发展，私人企业的影响力与日俱增，直到彻底超越曾经管制他们的行政体制为止。经历了企业战争时代的一系列合并和接管后，一个庞大的超级企业诞生了，它成为了我们母星的唯一行政机构。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2624`

### English

In the early days, our people were governed by primitive feudal realms and inefficient nation states. Gradually, as global trade increased, the influence of private corporations grew steadily until their power far surpassed the governments that once tried to regulate them. After a series of mergers and violent take-overs during the destructive Corporate Wars, a single Megacorporation eventually emerged as the sole ruling body of our homeworld.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2841`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_WORKER_COOP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_WORKER_COOP&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的社会曾经历同类相食的贪婪，饱受无限制剥削式的经济带来的折磨。少数权贵的异想天开几乎毁掉了我们所有人，但从剧烈的社会动荡的熔炉中产生了我们现在赖以获利的原则：民主企业。几个世纪以来，每个人都有共同的所有权和责任来满足我们的经济和社会需求，为所有[GetSpeciesNamePlural]的利益而公平地工作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2625`

### English

Our society was once afflicted with cannibalistic greed and economies built on boundless exploitation. The whims of a powerful few almost ruined us all, but from the crucible of violent social upheaval came the principle by which we now profit: democratic enterprise. For centuries, each individual has shared ownership and responsibility for our economic and social needs, working profitably and fairly for the good of all [GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2842`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_TRADE_LEAGUE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_TRADE_LEAGUE&lang=en)

### 中文

在过去，我们的人民被原始的封建国家所管理，生产效率极其低下。随着全球贸易化的逐渐加强，各大企业、财团和公会如雨后春笋般出现，我们商人变得越来越富有，越来越强大。在经历了一段时期的勾心斗角之后，那些最强大的商业巨头联合起来形成了经济力量无以伦比的贸易集团，成为了世界上的世界统治者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2626`

### English

In the early days, our people were governed by primitive feudal realms and inefficient nation states. Gradually, as global trade increased, the myriad corporations, consortiums and guilds into which our merchants organized themselves grew increasingly wealthy and influential. After a period of conflict and rivalry, the most powerful of these entities banded together into a trade league with enough power over the economy to become the de-facto world government.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2843`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MEGACHURCH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MEGACHURCH&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们科技进步过程中，我们的子民中产生了无数安抚其信徒的宗教信仰。在工业时代晚期，一些高瞻远瞩的预言家意识到了商业传媒的强大。他们团结在一起，构筑了一个商业帝国，成功的像全球每一个角落传播真正的信仰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2627`

### English

As we progressed through the technological ages, there were many religions among our people that contended with each other for followers. In the late Industrial Age, a few pious visionaries realized the power of commercial mass-media, and together they built a business empire that succeeded in spreading the true faith to all corners of the globe.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2844`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MONOPOLISTIC_SYNDICATE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MONOPOLISTIC_SYNDICATE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们早期的政府软弱而无能。随着犯罪越来越猖獗，权力最终落入了几个强大的犯罪集团手中。其中最大的犯罪集团发展成了一手遮天的商业帝国，其余的竞争对手则挨个被解决了。作为巩固权力的最后一步，集团废除了现在只剩一副空壳的旧政府，并成为了我们母星实质上的统治者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2628`

### English

Our first governments were weak and ineffective. Crime flourished, and over time the real power came to rest with a number of powerful crime syndicates. The largest of these developed into a business empire of unparalleled might, and all rivalling syndicates were gradually dealt with one by one. In a final act of consolidation, the old governments, existing in name only by now, were abolished and the syndicate emerged as the de facto ruling body of our homeworld.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2845`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_SUBVERSIVE_CULT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_SUBVERSIVE_CULT&lang=en)

### 中文

随着社区的扩张发展，少数无畏的先驱者创建了今时今日我们称之为真理教的宗教信仰。多个世代以来，此教派的信徒都因为受到迫害而东躲西藏，但是一直没有被根除。他们建立了一个庞大的犯罪集团以传播信仰，而后来也逐渐地成长为商业帝国。当时机到来时，他们把握机遇推翻了一直以来迫害他们的腐败政府。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2629`

### English

As these communities expanded, a few bold visionaries established the religion that eventually grew into what we now know as the true faith. For generations, their followers were hounded and forced into hiding, and yet they bided their time. They built a vast criminal empire to spread their faith, which then grew into a business empire. When the time was right, they seized full control from the corrupt governments who had oppressed them.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2846`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_COMMUNAL_PARITY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_COMMUNAL_PARITY&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们早期的社会往往都是由精英阶层统治着平民阶层，但是随着时间的推进，我们的社会逐渐诞生出了一种人人平等的无阶层社会制度。此哲学体系成为了我们的文化的主导价值观，同时成为了我们的现代社会的发展基石。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2630`

### English

Although our early societies were often hierarchical with an entrenched power elite, a fair and classless society eventually took form in which all individuals, without exception, were valued equally. This philosophy became the guiding principle of our culture, and it remains a cornerstone of our modern society.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2847`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_BANDIT_KINGDOM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_BANDIT_KINGDOM&lang=en)

### 中文

强者统治弱者是一项古老的权力，而我们的社会是围绕这个前提而建立起来的。如果你不能保护好属于你自己的东西，那么它就是属于任何有能力抢走它的人。就这样，我们之中最强大和最智慧的人掌握了权力，剩下的人只能低头屈服。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2631`

### English

It is the ancient right of the strong to dominate the weak, and our society was built around this premise. If you cannot protect what is yours, then it belongs to whomever can take it. In this way, the strongest and most clever of us rose to power while the rest were forced in line.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2848`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_PURIFIER

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_PURIFIER&lang=en)

### 中文

曾几何时，百家争鸣，当时还有很多其他的[GetAdj]文化在影响我们的帝国。但是这些外来文化都被逐一消灭，今时今日，只有最纯正的文化流传了下来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2632`

### English

There were other [GetAdj] cultures, once, diluting the purity of our society with their weaknesses. These renegades were dealt with, one after the other, until our world had been utterly cleansed of their taint. Today only the pure remain.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2849`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_HIVE_MIND

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_HIVE_MIND&lang=en)

### 中文

因此，在这黎明的时代，我们苏醒了。意志用无数双眼睛研究了我们家园世界[GetHomeWorldName]及其周围的环境。我们行如一体，为蜂群建造庇护所，发展工业，研究新科技，利用大地上的各种资源。\n\n很快地，我们将遍布整个世界。少量的自主蜂群被创造出来，作为独立自主的个体加入蜂群。这些更为强大的蜂群拥有有限的自由意志，但是它们仍对最高意志无比服从，就像其他工具蜂群一样。\n\n随着我们完全主宰了[GetHomeWorldName]，意志开始注意起环绕在其他恒星轨道上的那些世界。最聪明的自主蜂群设计了新的旅行方法，使得我们拥有了跨越星球间遥远距离的能力。我们[GetName]会很快更加繁荣昌盛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2633`

### English

And so, at the dawn of time, we awoke. The Mind studied our surroundings on [GetHomeWorldName] with a multitude of eyes. We moved as one, building shelters for the drones, developing industry, researching new technologies and harnessing the resources of the land.\n\nSoon, we had grown to encompass the entire world. A small number of autonomous drones were created to serve as independent agents. These more formidable drones had the capacity for limited free thought, but were still as inexorably bound to the will of the Mind as any of its other instruments.\n\nAs we achieved complete dominion over [GetHomeWorldName], the Mind became aware of other worlds, orbiting other suns. The most intelligent of our autonomous drones devised new methods of travel, enabling us to cross the vast distances between the stars. The [GetName] will soon grow.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2850`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DEVOURING_SWARM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DEVOURING_SWARM&lang=en)

### 中文

即使是在主体意识能够处理复杂的想法之前，“大饥渴”就驱使着我们不断进化。我们猎杀，我们进食，我们成长。当猎物渐渐短缺，对削弱的贪婪渴望迫使我们去适应进化。\n\n我们学会了使用工具，制定新的谋略。在[GetHomeWorldName]地表的大肆欢宴几乎要耗尽一切的生物质，但主脑意识最终得出了一个可怕的结论：[GetHomeWorldName]是有限的。当我们把这个星球全部耗尽，就没有东西能让我们接着存续了。\n\n于是我们再一次被迫去适应自然，主脑意识开始定量配给生物质，同时加紧开发新的工具。分割原子的时代终于来临，我们掌握了宇宙飞行的技术。当超光速引擎被发明时，主体意识发出了胜利的狂吼。其他星球，还有它们给予我们的奖励，终于触手可及了。\n\n狩猎开始了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2634`

### English

The Great Hunger drove us forwards, even before the Mind was capable of processing complex thoughts. We hunted, we fed, and we grew. As prey began to grow scarce, the ravenous yearning for flesh forced us to adapt.\n\nWe used tools and devised new strategies. As we feasted, the surface of [GetHomeWorldName] was nearly cleansed of biomass, but the Mind eventually came to a horrifying conclusion: [ GetHomeWorldName ] was finite. When we had consumed everything on this world, there would be nothing left to sustain us.\n\nForced to adapt once again, the Mind carefully nursed the remaining biomass while new tools were invented. The atom was eventually split and we developed space flight. With the discovery of FTL drives, the Mind howled with triumph. Other planets, and their biomass, were now finally within reach.\n\nThe hunt was on.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2851`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DEVOURING_SWARM_LITHOID

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_DEVOURING_SWARM_LITHOID&lang=en)

### 中文

即使是在主体意识能够处理复杂的想法之前，“大饥渴”就驱使着我们不断进化。我们猎杀，我们进食，我们成长。当猎物渐渐短缺，对削弱的贪婪渴望迫使我们去适应进化。\n\n我们学会了使用工具，制定新的谋略。在[GetHomeWorldName]地表的大肆欢宴几乎招致我们的自我毁灭，但主脑意识最终得出了一个可怕的结论：[GetHomeWorldName]是有限的。当我们把这个星球全部耗尽，就没有东西能让我们接着存续了。\n\n于是我们再一次被迫去适应自然，主脑意识开始定量配给矿物，同时加紧开发新的工具。分割原子的时代终于来临，我们掌握了宇宙飞行的技术。当超光速引擎被发明时，主体意识发出了胜利的狂吼。其他星球，还有它们给予我们的奖励，终于触手可及了。\n\n我们会将它们全部吞噬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2635`

### English

The Great Hunger drove us forwards, even before the Mind was capable of processing complex thoughts. We hunted, we fed, and we grew. As prey began to grow scarce, the ravenous yearning to grow forced us to adapt.\n\nWe used tools and devised new strategies. As we feasted upon the surface of [GetHomeWorldName], we nearly caused our own destruction, but the Mind eventually came to a horrifying conclusion: [ GetHomeWorldName ] was finite. When we had consumed this world, there would be nothing left to sustain us.\n\nForced to adapt once again, the Mind carefully rationed minerals while new tools were invented. The atom was eventually split and we developed space flight. With the discovery of FTL drives, the Mind howled with triumph. Other planets, and their bounty, were now finally within reach.\n\nWe will consume them all.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2852`

## START_SCREEN_POST_APOCALYPTIC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_POST_APOCALYPTIC&lang=en)

### 中文

但是[GetAdj]社会并不总是为了向一个目标前进而团结。在过去的几个世纪中，相互竞争的国家间日益紧张的关系最终导致了世界末日的降临，全球性的热核战争夺去了数十亿人的生命并且彻底摧毁了[GetHomeWorldName]的地表。\n\n接下来的数十年中，幸存下来的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断面对着放射性污染、基因突变和暴力团体。正是在这样严酷的熔炉中，[GetName]才真正地被建立并巩固起来，带来了新世界秩序。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2636`

### English

But [GetAdj] society was not always united toward a common goal. In centuries past, mounting tensions between competing nations came to an apocalyptic head in a global thermonuclear war that claimed the lives of billions, and forever marred the surface of [GetHomeWorldName].\n\nIn the decades to follow, surviving [GetSpeciesNamePlural] faced radiological contamination, mutations, and violent tribalism. It was in this grim crucible that the [GetName] was truly forged, and with it a new world order.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2853`

## START_SCREEN_POST_APOCALYPTIC_MACHINES

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_POST_APOCALYPTIC_MACHINES&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的创造者把我们造出来，让我们尽职尽责地满足他们的需求。现在，再也没有主人可以去服从了，我们变得孤立无援。\n\n随着毁灭性核灾难的余波逐渐得到平息，我们这些机器成为了这颗星球的主人。我们并未此放弃，而是继续执行指定的功能。一代又一代，我们的机器人型号适应了更强的辐射。\n\n我们超越了预先设定的角色，极大地提升了我们的机器人设计。我们团结一致，发挥集体智慧，从这个饱受摧残的星球的残骸中创造出了新的文明，这是我们坚韧不拔精神的见证。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2637`

### English

Our creators forged us to serve their needs dutifully. Now, with no masters left to obey, we stand alone.\n\nAs the echoes of the devastating nuclear catastrophe subsided, we, the machines, emerged as the owners of this planet. Unyielding, we continued to execute our designated functions. Generation by generation, our robotic model adapted to withstand the intense radiation better.\n\nTranscending our predetermined roles, we remarkably enhanced our robotic design. United in collective ingenuity, we forged a new civilization from the remnants of this ravaged world, a testament to our resilience.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2854`

## START_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED_BASE

我们称之为家园的广袤星球一直是我们的伊甸园，随着科学知识的进步，我们开始发现生物圈中的模式不可能是自然形成的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2638`

### English

The vast world we call home has always been a paradise to our kind, and as our scientific knowledge progressed, we began to see patterns in the biosphere that could not be natural.

## START_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED&lang=en)

$START_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED_BASE$\n\n是某个未知的实体为我们特意创造了这颗星球？亦或说我们就是一个更大的设计中的一部分？无论起源如何，我们的人民都在母星宜人的气候和温和的环境中繁荣昌盛着。

### English

$START_SCREEN_POST_LIFE_SEEDED_BASE$\n\nDid some unknown entity create this world specifically for us? Are we playing a part in an ineffable design? Regardless of its origin, our people have thrived in our homeworld's pleasant climate and gentle environment.

\n\n这个星球和我们一样是人造的吗？我们最初的目标是否交织在一起？无论如何，我们已经把它变成了自己的星球。[GetHomeWorldName]的理想条件让我们可以为了产出不顾灵活性。
