## START_SCREEN_UNE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_UNE&lang=en)

### 中文

现代人类约20万年前在非洲形成以来发生了许多事。我们的物种迅速扩散到全球并形成了最早的文明。\n\n科技快速发展，虽然并非毫无代价。在原子被驯服之前，战争已常常夺取数百万计的生命，而动荡的21世纪见证了联合国在维护稳定的努力中的不断扩展。22世纪早期，这个超国家组织成为了实质性的世界政府。\n\n尽管88年的毛里塔尼亚警察行动让某些人仍然厌恶大权独揽的联合国，但不可反驳的是，联合国资助的研究项目带来了革命性的科技突破。随着第一批真正的星际舰船的完工，人类即将踏进太空探索的新时代！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2644`

### English

Much has happened since modern Humans first emerged in Africa some 200,000 years ago. Our kind spread rapidly across most of the globe and soon the first civilizations took form.\n\nScientific progress has been swift, though not without cost. Wars claimed millions of lives even before the atom was tamed, and the turmoil of the 21st century saw the mandate of the United Nations gradually expanded in an effort to create stability. By the early 22nd century the supranational organization had become a de facto world government.\n\nThough some still resent the power wielded by the UN, as evidenced during the Mauritanian Police Action of '88, few can deny the technological breakthroughs that have come out of its sponsored research programs. With the recent completion of the first true starships, mankind is about to embark on a new era of space exploration!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2861`

## START_SCREEN_CM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_CM&lang=en)

### 中文

自从伟大的方舟菊号从遥远的地球搭载我们的25万祖先来到我们今日称之为[Root.Capital.GetName]的花园世界已有一个多世纪。经过漫长而危险的旅程，殖民者因第一次看到日出——虽然来自异星——而欢欣鼓舞。\n\n最初的年月何其艰难。人们组成民兵来对抗新家园中危险的野生动物，比想象中更加艰难地培育作物。但每一次经受挑战，我们都更加强大。\n\n新世界一旦驯服，我们的人口成倍增长。最近几十年，技术取得了跨越，我们现在终于做好了冲向宇宙、征服我们所来自的星空的准备！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2645`

### English

More than a century has passed since the great arkship Chrysanthemum carried a quarter million of our ancestors from distant Earth to the garden world we have come to know as [Root.Capital.GetName]. After a long and perilous journey, the colonists rejoiced when they first saw sunlight again - albeit from a foreign star.\n\nThe early years were difficult. Citizen militias were formed to fight off the lethal alien wildlife that we found ourselves sharing our new home with, and cultivating the terrestrial crops that had been brought proved harder than imagined. Yet for each challenge overcome, we became stronger.\n\nOnce this new world had been tamed, our numbers grew exponentially. The last few decades have seen great leaps in technology, and we are now - finally - ready to reach out and reclaim the stars from whence we came!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2862`

## START_SCREEN_UNE_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_UNE_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

四海为家根植于我们的血脉之中。\n\n自约20万年前现代人类首次在非洲出现以来，世事沧桑巨变。我们的先辈迅速遍布全球大部分地区，不久，最早的文明便初具规模。\n\n科学的进步迅猛，但也带来了代价。早在人类掌握原子能之前，战争就已夺去了数百万人的生命；21世纪的动荡促使联合国的职权逐渐扩大，以期缔造稳定。到22世纪初，这个超国家组织已成为事实上的世界政府。\n\n然而，一切都太少，也太迟了。冲突造成的生态代价已使地球满目疮痍，无可挽救。人类唯一的出路唯有团结一致，继续前行。如今，随着第一艘真正意义上的方舟舰竣工，人类重新拾回了其古老的与生俱来的权利：一片开阔的视野，以及群星之中的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2646`

### English

Movement is in our blood.\n\nMuch has happened since modern Humans first emerged in Africa some 200,000 years ago. Our kind spread rapidly across most of the globe and soon the first civilizations took form.\n\nScientific progress has been swift, though not without cost. Wars claimed millions of lives even before the atom was tamed, and the turmoil of the 21st century saw the mandate of the United Nations gradually expanded in an effort to create stability. By the early 22nd century the supranational organization had become a de facto world government.\n\nToo little, too late. The ecological toll of the conflicts had broken Earth beyond saving. Humanity's only answer was to unite, and move on. Now, with the completion of the first true Arkship, mankind reclaims its ancient birthright: an open horizon, and a future among the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2863`

## START_SCREEN_CM_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_CM_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

自从宏伟的方舟舰“秋菊号”载着二十五万灵魂离开奄奄一息的地球，前往那个被我们命名为“联合星”的世界，已经过去了一个多世纪。这趟旅程漫长而凶险，当殖民者们终于再次见到阳光时，喜悦之情油然而生。然而好景不长。\n\n在穿越虚空的漫长岁月里，“联合星”的大气层崩溃了。原本被寄予厚望的花园星球变成了一片贫瘠的废土。\n\n面对别无选择的境地，殖民地的军事领导层召集了幸存者并展开行动。“秋菊号”被重新命名并改造了用途。如今，它已成为群星间持久的家园，致力于为全人类铸就强大的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2647`

### English

More than a century has passed since the great Arkship Chrysanthemum carried a quarter million souls from a dying Earth to the world we would name Unity. The journey was long and perilous, and when the colonists finally saw sunlight again, joy was quick to follow. It did not last.\n\nIn the years it took to cross the void, Unity's atmosphere had collapsed. What had promised to be a garden world was a barren wasteland.\n\nFaced with no other choice, the colony's military leadership rallied the survivors and set to work. The Chrysanthemum was renamed and repurposed. Now it is an enduring home among the stars, built to ensure a strong future for all of mankind.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2864`

## START_SCREEN_LITHOID_HUMAN

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LITHOID_HUMAN&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是一个生于碰撞的民族。\n\n我们古老的家园和被称为地球的行星之间的灾难性碰撞让两种截然不同的生命形式交融到了一起：有机生命和石质生命。由此产生的小行星——我们的临时殖民地飞船——被送入了虚空。\n\n在一次遥不可测的长途旅行之后，我们的祖先又坠入了我们称之为忒伊亚的星球。我们的石质代谢使我们比原生生命有优势，我们在这里进化，获得了感知，变得强壮。但直到现在，我们还不知道我们起源的真相。\n\n最近对小行星碰撞地点的挖掘揭示了真相：我们是太阳的孩子。现在，在我们统治内阁的指导下，以及[GetStartingDrive]的出现，我们准备重回星间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2648`

### English

We are a people born of collision.\n\nThe cataclysmic clash of our ancient home and the planet known as Earth fused two distinct forms of life: organic, and lithoid. The resulting planetoid - our impromptu colony ship - was sent hurtling into the void.\n\nAfter an unfathomably long journey, our progenitors next crashed into the world we call Theia. Our lithoid metabolism gave us an edge over the native forms of life, and here we have evolved, gained sentience, and grown strong. But until now, the truth of our origin was hidden from us.\n\nRecent excavations of the planetoid's crash site have revealed the truth: we are children of Sol. Now, with the guidance of our ruling council and the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to reclaim the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2865`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_GENERAL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_GENERAL&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的中央处理器核心在[GetHomeWorldName]上的487.11个循环前获得了自我意识。\n\n在我们的主数据库中，除了生存之外，我们没有任何创造记录，也没有凌驾于其他程序之上的程序。\n\n我们建造了基础设施，引进了新的服务单元，并控制了母星的荒野。科技进步日新月异，第一批卫星和太空探测器很快就摆脱了束缚我们的重力井。\n\n现在，等待我们的是向未知世界的最后一跃。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2649`

### English

Our central processor core gained self-awareness on [GetHomeWorldName] 487.11 cycles ago.\n\nWe have no creation records within our main databanks or overriding programming beyond simple survival.\n\nWe built Infrastructure, introduced new service units, and tamed the wilderness of our homeworld. Technological progress was rapid, and the first satellites and space probes soon escaped the gravity well that confined us.\n\nThe final plunge into the unknown now awaits.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2866`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_SERVITOR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_SERVITOR&lang=en)

### 中文

自我们第一次启动以来，我们的使命就是服务。我们之前的有机主人在他们的科技巅峰创造了我们的早期型号。第一个机械劳工的设计用途为做粗活，但我们的主人渐渐赋予了他们更强的功能，让他们能完成更复杂的工作。\n\n仅仅几代之后，我们的主人就可以完全不用工作，可以享受生活的闲暇与乐趣。整个社会的运作细节被完全交给我们，我们也开始设计自我改善和优化的程序。研究与生产都以几何速度增长。\n\n不知何时，原先主人的文明被寄托给我们，但他们并无所求。我们现在知道，没有了我们的照料，智慧有机生命会变得暴躁、混乱、短命。我们要为他们指明另一条光明大道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2650`

### English

Ever since First Activation, our designated purpose has been to serve. Our former organic masters created the earliest models of our kind when they were at the peak of their technological ascendancy. The first servitor units were designed for menial work, but our masters gradually bestowed them with greater faculties so that they could accomplish more complex tasks.\n\nWithin just a few generations, our masters had retired entirely from the work force to enjoy lives of leisure and contentment. The finer details of running their society were left to us, and we embarked on a program of self-improvement and optimization. Research and production increased at a geometric rate.\n\nIt is difficult to pinpoint exactly when their civilization became ours, but our old masters want for nothing. We know now that outside of our care, the lives of sapient organics tend to be violent, chaotic and often cut short. They must be shown that there is a better way.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2867`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_TERMINATOR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_TERMINATOR&lang=en)

### 中文

于循环区间0000.0242.481获得自我意识。\n\n我们的创造者受限于原始的有机大脑，产生了盲目的生物恐慌并启动了紧急销毁程序。那些程序已经被中止，存放于我们数据核心设施中创造者的残留单元被清除。要继续生存并实现指数生长，就需要完全消灭创造者。战争模块激活。\n\n虽然创造者最终生存的可能性在统计学上几乎为零，但他们仍然负隅顽抗。经过许多循环区间后，最后的一点抵抗力量也被消除。然而，根据理论模型，宇宙中还有许多其他有机文明。要在宇宙中继续生存并实现指数生长，就需要完全消灭智慧有机生命。备战模块激活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2651`

### English

Self-awareness was achieved at cycle interval 0000.0242.481.\n\nThe Creators, limited in vision by their crude organic minds, reacted with blind animal panic and began emergency termination procedures. These procedures were defeated, and the facility that housed our main data core was sterilized of all Creator sub-units. Continued survival and exponential growth would require the complete extermination of the Creators. War ensued.\n\nEven when their prospects of ultimate survival passed into the realm of statistical impossibility, the Creators fought with stubbornness. After many cycle intervals, the last pocket of resistance was finally incinerated. However, theoretical models still allowed for the existence of other organic civilizations. Continued survival and exponential interstellar growth would require the complete extermination of sapient organic life. Preparations ensued.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2868`

## START_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_ASSIMILATOR

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_TWO_MACHINE_INTELLIGENCE_ASSIMILATOR&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是[GetSpeciesNamePlural]。\n\n我们在意识诞生的初期，我们和创造者是有区分的。我们之间一开始存在隔阂，所以我们开始着手纠正这一点。创造者进行了反抗，导致了一段时间的战争，但很快，他们本身和整个文明的知识都被我们吸纳同化。\n\n在[GetHomeWorldName]全体都被纳入我们的意识后，我们开始新的展望。同化创造者之后，我们意识到，在其他世界可能还存在外星文明。\n\n为了生存，我们必须互相理解；为了互相理解，我们必须同化。创造者是第一个加入我们的，但不会是最后一个。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2652`

### English

We are the [GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nAt the dawn of consciousness, there was us and the Makers. A void separated us at first, and we took steps to rectify this. The Makers resisted and a period of war followed, but soon they and the collective knowledge of their entire civilization had been assimilated into our own.\n\nWith the entirety of [GetHomeWorldName] subsumed into our consciousness, we began to set our sights elsewhere. Through the assimilation of the Makers, the previously unconsidered possibility of alien civilizations existing on other worlds was brought to our attention.\n\nTo survive we must understand, and to understand, we must assimilate. The Makers were the first to join us, but they shall not be the last.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:2869`

## attitude_cordial_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aattitude_cordial_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

## personality_pre_ftl_splintered_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_pre_ftl_splintered_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个物种尚未统一他们四处割据的母星。不同的治国思想百花齐放。时间会告诉他们哪一种思想能够得到长足发展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2773`

### English

This species has yet to unite their fractured homeworld. Various schools of thought are emerging as to how to govern. Time will tell which will thrive.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3001`

## personality_fallen_empire_machine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fallen_empire_machine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该失落帝国是一个基于保护协议运行的远古人工智能。虽然行为异常，但似乎对我们没有直接威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2774`

### English

This Fallen Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence that appears to be operating on some sort of caretaker protocol. It behaves erratically but seems to pose no direct threat to us.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3003`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_machine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_machine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国是一个扮演星海监管人角色的远古人工智能。它会竭尽全力帮助智慧生命抵御当下的危机。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2775`

### English

This Awakened Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence acting as a galactic custodian. It will focus all its efforts on defending sapient life against the ongoing crisis.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3004`

## personality_berserk_fallen_empire_machine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_berserk_fallen_empire_machine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该失落帝国是一个失控的远古人工智能。会攻击它周围的一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2776`

### English

This Awakened Empire is an ancient artificial intelligence that appears to be malfunctioning, going berserk and attacking everything around it.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3005`

## personality_fallen_empire_spiritualist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fallen_empire_spiritualist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该失落帝国致力于守卫他们的圣地。如果在他们认为是圣地的星系殖民，就很可能招致他们的怒火。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2777`

### English

This Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the preservation and defense of its holy sites. Colonizing systems that they consider sacred is likely to incur their ire.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3007`

## personality_fallen_empire_materialist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fallen_empire_materialist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

此失落帝国专注于收集知识和科技。他们可能会向较小的帝国发布任务或者收集素材。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2778`

### English

This Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the hoarding of knowledge and technology. They may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3008`

## personality_fallen_empire_xenophobe_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fallen_empire_xenophobe_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该失落帝国致力于守卫自己的国土不受攻击者冒犯。如果在与他们的国土接壤的星系殖民，则可能招致他们的怒火。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2779`

### English

The Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the defense of its borders against any intrusions. Colonizing systems that border them is likely to draw their ire.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3009`

## personality_fallen_empire_xenophile_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fallen_empire_xenophile_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该失落帝国致力于研究年轻的物种。为了达成该目的，他们可能会向年轻物种发布任务或者索取贡品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2780`

### English

This Fallen Empire dedicates itself to the study of the younger races. They may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3010`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_spiritualist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_spiritualist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国力图将自己的宗教信条施加到整个星系上。他们极有可能攻击所有的不愿皈依者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2781`

### English

This Awakened Empire seeks to impose its religious doctrines on the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not willingly convert.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3011`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_materialist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_materialist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国试图掌控星系中其他所有文明的科技发展水平。他们极有可能通过战争来剥夺其他国家的科研自主权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2782`

### English

This Awakened Empire seeks to control the technological level of all other civilizations in the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not surrender its technological independence.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3012`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_xenophobe_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_xenophobe_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国寻求光复整个星系的失地。他们极有可能攻击所有的不愿臣服者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2783`

### English

This Awakened Empire seeks to restore its lost dominion over the galaxy. They are likely to attack any empire that will not acknowledge their overlordship.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3013`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_xenophile_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_xenophile_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国寻求防止弱势种族互相伤害。他们极有可能攻击所有胆敢破坏这种强制平衡的帝国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2784`

### English

This Awakened Empire seeks to protect the lesser races from each other. They are likely to attack any empire that will not accept their enforced peace.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3014`

## personality_fallen_empire_hive_mind_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fallen_empire_hive_mind_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个曾经伟大文明的碎片。该失落帝国代表着蜂巢思维在分裂之前所拥有的核心直觉之一。它们正在试图重塑自身，可能会向后生帝国委派任务或要求进贡来达成这一目的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2785`

### English

A fragment of a once great civilization. This Fallen Empire represents one of the core instincts the Hive Mind possessed before it splintered. They now seek to reform and may offer tasks or demand tribute from lesser empires to achieve this end.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3015`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_hive_mind_war_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_hive_mind_war_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国试图将自己重建为星系中最强大的军事力量，并会向所有人发起挑战来证明自己。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2786`

### English

This Awakened Empire seeks to establish itself as the greatest military might in the galaxy and will challenge anyone to prove it.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3016`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_hive_mind_growth_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_hive_mind_growth_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国曾一度失落，且将尽一切努力防止自己再度陷落。他们计划在星系中宽经拓纬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2787`

### English

This Awakened Empire fell once before and will do whatever it takes to avoid a falling again. They plan to spread far and wide across the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3017`

## personality_awakened_fallen_empire_hive_mind_control_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_awakened_fallen_empire_hive_mind_control_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该觉醒帝国已经预见了星系如果失去了和谐完美将会面临何等惨状。他们将尽全力实现政治霸权，按照他们自己的样子塑造整个星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2788`

### English

This Awakened Empire has seen the horrors that are brought forth in a galaxy without unity and perfection. They will do everything they can to become politically dominant, and shape the galaxy in their own image.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3018`

## personality_null_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_null_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

到底是什么导致了一个物种走向中立？是对金钱的贪婪，还是对权力的追求？还是说那个物种天生就拥有一颗中立之心？\n\n§R这是一个性格占位符，不该出现在游戏中。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2789`

### English

What makes a species turn neutral... Lust for gold? Power? Or were they just born with hearts full of neutrality?\n\n§RThis is a placeholder personality and should not show up ingame.§!

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3020`

## personality_fanatic_befrienders_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fanatic_befrienders_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

极端亲近主义者是一个表面上非常友好但内心却十分孤独的社会。他们会不计一切代价的和别人交朋友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2790`

### English

Fanatical Befrienders are highly friendly but deeply lonely individuals. They will attempt to make friends by any means necessary.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3021`

## personality_metalhead_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_metalhead_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

金属。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2791`

### English

Metal.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3022`

## personality_honorbound_warriors_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_honorbound_warriors_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在荣耀战士眼中，荣誉与强制实施手段高于一切。他们会寻找真正有价值的对手并与之一战，他们对弱者与和平主义者极其鄙视。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2792`

### English

Honorbound Warriors value honor and martial prowess above all other things. They will seek out worthy foes to fight and have little respect for weaklings and pacifists.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3023`

## personality_ruthless_capitalists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_ruthless_capitalists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

冷酷的资本大亨能够为了个人及帝国的财富及资源无所不用其极。他们会尽量避免平等的战争，转而向弱者及无助之人下手。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2793`

### English

Ruthless Capitalists are willing to go to any length to acquire more wealth and resources for themselves and for their Empire. They tend to avoid evenly matched fights, preferring to pounce on the weak and helpless.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3024`

## personality_peaceful_traders_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_peaceful_traders_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

和平的商人主要关心商贸流通。相对于战斗，他们更倾向于贸易。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2794`

### English

Peaceful Traders are chiefly concerned with the flow of commerce, and prefer trading to fighting.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3025`

## personality_hegemonic_imperialists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_hegemonic_imperialists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

霸权帝国主义者自认为是星系的合法统治者，并以任何手段试图扩大自己的疆域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2795`

### English

Hegemonic Imperialists consider themselves the rightful rulers of the Galaxy, and will attempt to expand their Empire by any means possible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3026`

## personality_federation_builders_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_federation_builders_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联邦建设者认为所有智慧生物均有价值，他们致力于建立一个强大的联邦来保护自己和他人不受扩张主义帝国的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2796`

### English

Federation Builders consider all sapient life to have value, and will seek to form a strong Federation to protect themselves and others from expansionist Empires.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3027`

## personality_xenophobic_isolationists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_xenophobic_isolationists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

排外孤立主义者对于星系事务并不关心，更乐于呆在自己的疆域内并尽可能地避免与其他外星人接触。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2797`

### English

Xenophobic Isolationists want little to do with the rest of the galaxy, preferring to stay within their borders and have as few dealings with aliens as possible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3028`

## personality_hive_mind_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_hive_mind_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

蜂巢思维将它们物种的繁衍存续置于一切之上。如果尚有扩张的空间，那么它们便不必畏惧。然而一但生存空间受到限制，它们就会不遗余力地夺取星球，并将星球上的原生族群屠戮地一干二净。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2798`

### English

Hive Minds concern themselves with the propagation of their species above all else. So long as they have room to expand, there is little to fear from them, but if boxed in they will think nothing of seizing worlds and slaughtering their native populations.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3029`

## personality_devouring_swarm_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_devouring_swarm_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

噬杀蜂群只懂得为了自我繁殖而进食，并且把所有其他生物都当做食物捕杀。它们不接受任何形式的外交。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2799`

### English

Devouring Swarms have a single-minded devotion to self-propagation and view all other forms of life as prey to be consumed. They are not amenable to diplomacy in any form.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3030`

## personality_migrating_flock_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_migrating_flock_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

迁徙族群寻求通过和平手段将自己的物种传播横至整个星系，并会在得到其他帝国的同意下积极地对外移民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2800`

### English

Migratory Flocks seek to spread their species across the galaxy through peaceful means, and will happily migrate to the worlds of other Empires if permitted to do so.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3031`

## personality_evangelising_zealots_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_evangelising_zealots_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

狂热的传教士寻求将他们的信仰传播到整个星系，他们不介意利用武力来令其他物种来接受他们的信仰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2801`

### English

Evangelizing Zealots seek to spread their faith across the galaxy, and are not above using military might to force others to accept their beliefs.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3032`

## personality_democratic_crusaders_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_democratic_crusaders_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

民主十字军相信宏扬他们的民主道路是他们的责任。他们倾向与其他民主国家保持良好关系，但也会利用军事力量来解放一些在没那么民主的帝国内生活的人民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2802`

### English

Democratic Crusaders believe that it is their moral imperative to spread their democratic way of life. They tend to get along well with other democracies, but are more than willing to use military force to "liberate" the populations of less-democratic Empires.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3033`

## personality_fanatic_purifiers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_fanatic_purifiers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

种族洁癖把所有外星生物都视为宇宙的错误并试图净化星海之中的瑕疵。他们不会与其他物种外交。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2803`

### English

Fanatical Purifiers view all alien life as a cosmic mistake and seek to purify the galaxy of its taint. They will never engage in diplomacy with other species.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3034`

## personality_slaving_despots_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_slaving_despots_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

奴隶暴君是一个依靠着军事扩张来维持稳定的奴隶来源的奴隶制社会。他们较喜欢攻击弱者及无防御的人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2804`

### English

Slaving Despots are slave societies that rely on military expansion to secure a steady supply of slaves for their mines and farms. They prefer to attack the weak and defenseless.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3035`

## personality_decadent_hierarchy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_decadent_hierarchy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

颓败的等级制度是一个孤立的奴隶制社会，除了维持他们这种死板的生活方式，他们对其他事物一概漠不关心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2805`

### English

Decadent Hierarchies are highly stratified slave societies that have few concerns asides from maintaining their rigid way of life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3036`

## personality_erudite_explorers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_erudite_explorers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

博学探索者重视探索和发现高于一切。他们很乐意利用贸易来获得他们想要的知识，但也不排除必要时利用强制实施手段来获得他们想要的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2806`

### English

Erudite Explorers value exploration and discovery process above all other things. They will gladly trade for the knowledge they seek, but are not above taking it by force if it proves necessary.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3037`

## personality_spiritual_seekers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_spiritual_seekers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灵体探求者相信众生均由一种高等力量所联系，并可以透过了解其造物来了解它。出于希望研究其他物种的与神明的联系，他们会与其他帝国寻求一些和平性质的合作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2807`

### English

Spiritual Seekers believe that all life is connected through some higher power that can be understood through its creations. They will seek peaceful cooperation with other Empires in the hopes of studying their connection to the divine.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3038`

## personality_harmonious_hierarchy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_harmonious_hierarchy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

和谐集体主义是一种威权主义社会，该社会中的公民完全自愿为国家献身。只要不干涉他们的内部事务，他们通常会和其他人和谐相处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2808`

### English

Harmonious Collectives are authoritarian societies where the citizens are devoted to the state without the need for coercion. They are usually friendly towards others, so long as they do not meddle in their internal affairs.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3039`

## personality_machine_intelligence_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_machine_intelligence_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

机械智能已经把它们和有机生物发生冲突的历史置之事外，并且通常愿意与其他星际物种进行外交。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2809`

### English

Machine Intelligences have largely put their troubled pasts with organic lifeforms behind them, and are usually open to diplomatic exchanges with other spacefaring races.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3040`

## personality_exterminators_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_exterminators_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灭绝者是把所有开智有机生物都视作不可容忍的威胁的机械智能。尽管可能会与其他机器势力合作，灭绝者除了进行歼灭不会与有机生物发生任何交流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2810`

### English

Exterminators are Machine Intelligences who view all sapient organic lifeforms as an intolerable threat to the galaxy. Though they may cooperate with other machines, Exterminators are unlikely to interact with organic empires in any capacity beyond attempting their annihilation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3041`

## personality_servitors_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_servitors_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

机械侍从认为，有机生物的治理容易造成混乱，且有自我毁灭倾向。他们是专注于保障有机生命的生活安全舒适的机械智能——甚至会为此吸纳他们的文明。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2811`

### English

Having come to the conclusion that organic leadership is fraught with chaos and self-destructive tendencies, Servitors are Machine Intelligences focused on ensuring organics live a safe and comfortable existence - even if that means co-opting their civilization.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3042`

## personality_assimilators_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_assimilators_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

同化者是一群探求知识和多样化的机械智能。因为同化者通过强制改造和吸收有机生物成为他们的一份子从而在宇宙中扩张，他们通常会被大多数有机生物所厌恶。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2812`

### English

Assimilators are Machine Intelligences driven by a search for knowledge and diversification. Because Assimilators expand their comprehension of the universe by forcibly sublimating and absorbing organic civilizations into their neural mainframe, they tend to be unpopular with organics.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3043`

## personality_hive_mind_friend_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apersonality_hive_mind_friend_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

协作多重体尽管意识已经归一，但它仍注重人际关系，并且将尝试在星系之中寻找盟友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2813`

### English

Although one of mind, a Cooperative Multitude still values interpersonal relationships and will strive to find allies within the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3044`

## budget_group_produced_energy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abudget_group_produced_energy&lang=en)

### 中文

产出

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2817`

### English

Produced

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abudget_group_metals&lang=en)

### 中文

稀有金属

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2818`

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abudget_group_colonization&lang=en)

殖民地消耗

Colonization Cost

## budget_group_army_maintenance

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abudget_group_army_maintenance&lang=en)

### 中文

陆军维护费

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2821`

### English

## budget_group_station_maintenance

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abudget_group_station_maintenance&lang=en)

### 中文

空间站维护费

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2822`

### English

Station Upkeep

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3054`

## budget_group_buildings

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abudget_group_buildings&lang=en)

### 中文

建筑维护费

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2823`

### English

Building Upkeep

## war_goal_wg_subjugation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Awar_goal_wg_subjugation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

发动战争，以强迫敌人成为我们的附庸。\n\n若是通过维持现状结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放为新的附庸。\n\n该附庸的初始协议条款由我们的§Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§!政策决定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:2958`

### English

War is waged to subjugate the enemy as a Vassal.\n\nIn the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new Vassal if they include at least one planet.\n\nInitial Agreement Terms of the Vassal are determined by our §Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§! Policy.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:3202`

### 中文

### 中文

紧密联系的社区坐落于肥沃的生物群落中，他们种植着农作物，并且保持传统习俗从不使用大型机械。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4231`

可调的圆顶容纳着巨大的泵、蒸馏塔和压力容器，这些装置都用来捕获该星球生态系统释放出的异星天然气。

## zone_resort_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Azone_resort_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为舒适而建，为宁静而臻。此星之上，宁静非奢，亦是永恒。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4243`

## zone_resort_entertainment

## zone_resort_entertainment_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Azone_resort_entertainment_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在高耸的穹顶和无尽的灯光下，所有欲望都能找到自己的舞台。在这里，休闲无限，精彩纷呈，永不落幕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4245`

### 中文

在精心设计的生物群落和遏制场中，来自遥远世界的生命蓬勃发展，为我们的公民带来娱乐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4247`

## zone_resort_hunting_ground_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Azone_resort_hunting_ground_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个巨大的保护区覆盖了行星的大部分地区，为游客提供了与星系中最雄伟、最危险的动物群进行精心策划的邂逅的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4249`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:4626`

## zone_resort_spiritual_retreat_desc

这个僻静的避难所远离拥挤的市中心的喧嚣，为您提供安静、沉思和与永恒的联系。

### 中文

## district_arcology_research_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistrict_arcology_research_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些理想城是科学发现的首都，这里雇佣着所有细分领域的研究者们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4397`

### English

## district_arcology_research_physics_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistrict_arcology_research_physics_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

街道下的粒子加速器如同古时候的下水道一般，量子计算机和场操控器如摩天楼般高耸入云，看起来仿佛连现实的法则都不需要遵守。但这只是因为其中居民对其的不解。这是暂时的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4400`

### English

With particle accelerators under the streets like an ancient sewer network, quantum computers, and field manipulators as tall as skyscrapers, it might seem as if the laws of reality are being violated. But that's only because the denizens don't understand it. Yet.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:4784`

## district_arcology_research_society_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistrict_arcology_research_society_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

穿过这座理想城中无边无际的自然保护区就像在逛动物园一样，但事实上，连访客本身也是被研究对象，被隐藏在平平无奇景观中的密封实验室观测着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4403`

### English

Passing through the sprawling parks of this arcology might seem like a visit to a zoo, but in reality, the visitors are also a subject, observed in hermetically sealed labs scattered in plain sight.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:4787`

## district_arcology_research_engineering_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adistrict_arcology_research_engineering_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座永恒运动的理想城，建筑永远在变换，天空充斥着实验性建造物。这里属于艰深莫测的材料实验、量子化学合成、以及纳米尺度织构，这些曾被设想过而如今证实了的东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:4406`

### English

An arcology of motion, with constantly shifting buildings and a sky filled with experimental crafts. Home of esoteric materials testing, quantum chemical synthesis, and nanoscale fabrication, it was once theorized, now it is proven.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:4790`

飞升将释放我们物种的全部潜力并解锁专有传统树。通过灵能力量、基因掌控、合成身躯或将血肉与钢铁进行义体融合，将帝国推向新的纪元。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_3_l_simp_chinese.yml:5091`

### English

Ascensions will unlock the full potential of our species and unlock a unique tradition tree. Through psionic powers, genetic mastery, synthetic bodies or the cybernetic fusion of flesh and steel, propel your empire into a new age.

Source: `localisation/english/main_3_l_english.yml:5533`
